title: Airy Openwork Scrunchie
description:
💙实物好美！马海毛的空气感真是拔尖～ 好姐们儿给取名《人鱼泪》。
🌟图解改动：图解第一圈钩60x，第二圈不钩，第三圈钩6组（长长针，k9）
🧵：@回归线 慕颜 马海毛 🎨：靛青 🪄：2.5mm 📖：图6图解，图解改动和视频教程来自@大丽毛线编织
#钩针发圈 #镂空发圈 #钩针图解
author: Scarlett

patterns.englishText:
Airy Openwork Scrunchie — Mohair Lace Ring (based on motif #441)

Yarn: mohair, indigo. Hook: 2.5 mm. The base motif is doily chart #441 (a round lace medallion), adapted into a hair scrunchie.

Maker's adaptation (use this for the scrunchie)
Rnd 1: 60 sc worked around the hair tie / into the ring (60)
Rnd 2: skip (no round worked)
Rnd 3: *tr, ch 9* 6 times around — 6 tall arches (6 arches)

Reference — base lace motif #441 (round symbol chart)
Rnd 1: Begin with a small ring; work sc with short ch spaces around the center.
Rnds 2-3: Build up with short clusters of dc into ch loops.
Rnds 4-7: Each round forms a ring of dc fans (5-7 dc shells) separated by ch loops, the shells growing taller and the chain arches longer each round (the chart numbers the stitch height 4 through 7 within the shells).
Rnds 8-9: Outer rounds add scalloped sc edging and small picot tips along the points of the fans.
patterns.chineseText: 镂空发圈，参考蕾丝花样图解441（圆形符号图）。中心起针，圈1短针起，向外为长针扇形+锁针网格逐圈扩大，圈数标注1-9。博主图解改动：第一圈钩60x，第二圈不钩，第三圈钩6组（长长针，9ch）。马海毛，靛青色，2.5mm钩针。
patterns.notes: Hook: 2.5 mm. Yarn: indigo mohair (very airy/halo). The piece is a hair scrunchie adapted from lace doily motif #441 (shown on a book page numbered 440-442). Follow the maker's 3-round adaptation rather than the full doily: Rnd 1 = 60 sc around the elastic, Rnd 2 skipped, Rnd 3 = 6 x (tr + ch 9) arches. The printed #441 chart is the visual reference for the lace fan shaping.

meta.intro: This airy openwork scrunchie wraps a hair elastic in indigo mohair to create a soft, halo-like lace ring. Adapted from doily motif #441, it's a quick three-round project that turns a plain hair tie into a delicate accessory.

faq.question: Do I crochet the full doily motif #441?
faq.answer: No. Follow the maker's 3-round adaptation rather than the full doily: Round 1 is 60 sc worked around the elastic, Round 2 is skipped, and Round 3 is 6 repeats of (tr, ch 9) to form 6 tall arches. The printed #441 chart is just the visual reference for the lace fan shaping.

faq.question: Why use mohair for this scrunchie?
faq.answer: Indigo mohair gives the piece a very airy, halo-like fuzz that softens the openwork and makes the lace look delicate. It pairs well with the 2.5 mm hook and the loose ch-9 arches.

faq.question: How do I start the first round on a hair tie?
faq.answer: Work 60 sc directly around the hair tie / into the ring so the stitches encase the elastic, then build the 6 tall arches in Round 3 on top of that base.

title: Coll Crochet Net Hat
description:
✨转载注明出处，严禁商用！
#钩针帽子 #钩针教程 #编织图解 #图纸分享 #我的手工日常
author: 陆十七knit

patterns.englishText:
Coll Crochet Net Hat — Symbol Chart

This chart is the symbol-diagram companion to the written rounds (see the step photos / text). Worked flat in the round from a magic ring, increasing each round with dc clusters separated by chain spaces to form the lacy net.

Rnd 1: MR, ch 3 (counts as first dc), 13 dc in ring, sl st to join (14)
Rnd 2: Ch 3, dc in same st base, *ch 1, skip the base ch, (dc, ch 1, dc) in next st, ch 1, skip base ch*, rep 6 times, sl st to join (28)
Rnd 3: Ch 3, 2 dc from first st, *(2 dc, dc) in next st*, rep 13 times, sl st to join — increase 14 times around (42)
Rnd 4: Ch 3, *dc, ch 1, dc, ch 1, dc, ch 1 then (dc, ch 1, dc) group, ch 1*, rep around with 6 large groups, sl st to join (56)
Rnd 5: 7-dc fans separated by increases, ch 3 start, *7 dc, 2 dc in next st*, rep 6 times, sl st (63)
Rnd 6 onward: continue alternating 7-dc shell fans with single sc and ch-3 mesh arches around the crown, increasing as charted, then work straight rounds to shape the hat sides and a scalloped net brim, finishing with a chain tie (ch 90).
patterns.chineseText: Coll Crochet Net Hat | 콜 크로셰 네트햇 — circular crochet symbol chart (doily-style net hat crown). Chains, double-crochet bars and slip-stitch joins worked in expanding rounds; chain-spaces form the open net mesh.
patterns.notes: Worked flat in the round (doily-style crown) then shaped into a hat. Chart is the symbol version of the written pattern; cross-check stitch counts with the text rounds. Net effect comes from ch-1 / ch-3 spaces between dc groups.

patterns.englishText:
Coll Crochet Net Hat — Crown Rounds 1-5

Rnd 1: Make a magic ring, ch 3 (counts as first dc), 13 dc in ring, sl st to join (14)
Rnd 2: Ch 3 (counts as first dc), ch 1, dc in same first st, ch 1 (skip 1 base st); *(dc, ch 1, dc) in next st, ch 1 (skip 1 base st)*, rep 6 times, sl st to join (28)
Rnd 3: Ch 3 (counts as first dc), starting in the first st: 2 dc; *(2 dc in next st, 1 dc in next st)*, rep 13 times, sl st to join = increase every other st, 14 increases (42)
Rnd 4: Ch 3 (counts as first dc), ch 1, dc in first st, ch 1 (skip 1 base st), (dc, ch 1) twice; *(dc, ch 1, dc) in next st, ch 1, (dc, ch 1) twice*, rep 6 times, sl st to join (56)
Rnd 5: [increase every 7th st, 7 times, starting from the first st] = ch 3 (counts as first dc), dc in first st; *7 dc, 2 dc in next st*, rep 6 times, 7 dc, sl st to join (63)
patterns.chineseText:
1단: 매직링 만들어 사슬3(기둥코, 코수포함), 한길긴뜨기13, 빼뜨기 (14)
2단: 사슬3코(기둥코, 코수포함), 사슬1, 빼뜨기해준 첫코에 한길긴뜨기1, 사슬1(바닥코도 한코 건너띄기), [한코에(한길긴뜨기1, 사슬1, 한길긴뜨기1), 사슬1(바닥코도 한코 건너띄기)]X6번 반복, 빼뜨기 (28)
3단: 사슬3(기둥코, 코수포함), 빼뜨기해준 첫코부터 한길긴뜨기2, (한코에 한길긴뜨기2, 한길긴뜨기1)X13번 반복, 빼뜨기 = (한코건너 코늘리기 X14번) (42)
4단: 사슬3(기둥코, 코수포함), 사슬1, 빼뜨기해준 첫코에 한길긴뜨기1, 사슬1(바닥코도 한코 건너띄기), (한길긴뜨기1, 사슬1)X2번 반복, [한코에(한길긴뜨기1, 사슬1, 한길긴뜨기1), 사슬1, (한길긴뜨기1, 사슬1)X2번] X6번 반복, 빼뜨기 (56)
5단: [일곱코건너 코늘리기X7번(첫코부터 코늘려준다)] = 사슬3(기둥코, 코수포함), 빼뜨기해준 첫코에 한길긴뜨기1, (한길긴뜨기7, 한코에 한길긴뜨기2)X6번 반복, 한길긴뜨기7, 빼뜨기 (63)
patterns.notes: Korean-language pattern (단 = round, 한길긴뜨기 = dc, 짧은뜨기 = sc, 사슬 = ch, 빼뜨기 = sl st, 매직링 = magic ring). 기둥코/코수포함 = turning ch counts as a stitch. Page 1 of 3 of the written hat pattern, with step photos.

patterns.englishText:
Coll Crochet Net Hat — Crown Rounds 6-11

Rnd 6: Ch 1 (does NOT count as a stitch); *sc, ch 3 (skip 2 base sts)*, rep 20 times, sc, ch 1, dc in first st to join (21 ch-3 mesh arches)
Rnd 7: Working into the ch-spaces: *in same ch-sp (8 dc), (sc, ch 3), sc*, rep 6 times; 8 dc in same sp, sc, ch 1, dc into first st to join — forms 7 dc-fan shells
Rnd 8: *(dc, ch 1, sc in the post/leg of the dc) 7 times, dc, sc in ch-space*, rep 6 times; (dc, ch 3, sc in post of dc) 7 times, dc, sl st into the round's dc to join
Rnd 9: Ch 3 (counts as a stitch); *ch 5, sc in 3rd ch of previous arch, ch 5, sc in 5th ch, ch 5, dc in center sc of motif*, rep 6 times; ch 5, sc in 3rd ch, ch 5, sc in 5th ch, ch 2, dc in first st to join
Rnd 10: *ch 5, sc in center of ch-space*, rep 20 times, ch 2, dc in previous dc st to join
Rnd 11: Working into the ch-spaces: *8 dc in space, (sc, ch 5), sc*, rep 6 times; 8 dc in space, (sc, ch 2), dc in previous dc to join
patterns.chineseText:
6단: 사슬1(기둥코, 코수포함X), [짧은뜨기1, 사슬3(바닥코 2코 건너띄어준다)]X20번 반복, 짧은뜨기1, 사슬1, 첫코에 긴뜨기1
7단: (모두 사슬코부분에) [같은자리에 한길긴뜨기8, (짧은뜨기1,사슬3), 짧은뜨기1] X6번 반복, 같은자리에 한길긴뜨기8, 짧은뜨기1,사슬1, (전단 긴뜨기코에)긴뜨기1
8단: [(한길긴뜨기1, 사슬1, 한길긴뜨기 다리에 짧은뜨기1)X7번 반복, 한길긴뜨기1, (사슬코부분에)짧은뜨기1]X6번 반복, (한길긴뜨기1, 사슬3, 한길긴뜨기 다리에 짧은뜨기1)X7번 반복, 한길긴뜨기1, (전단 긴뜨기코에)빼뜨기
9단: 사슬3(기둥코, 코수에 포함), [사슬5, 세번째 사슬코부분에 짧은뜨기1, 사슬5, 다섯번째 사슬코부분에 짧은뜨기1, 사슬5, (무늬중앙 짧은뜨기코에)한길긴뜨기1]X6번 반복, 사슬5, 세번째 사슬코부분에 짧은뜨기1, 사슬5, 다섯번째 사슬코부분에 짧은뜨기1, 사슬2, 첫코에 한길긴뜨기1
10단: [사슬5, (사슬코부분 중앙에)짧은뜨기1]X20번 반복, 사슬2, (전단 한길긴뜨기코에)한길긴뜨기1
11단: (모두 사슬코부분에) [한길긴뜨기8, (짧은뜨기1, 사슬5), 짧은뜨기1]X6번 반복, 한길긴뜨기8, (짧은뜨기1, 사슬2), (전단 한길긴뜨기코에)한길긴뜨기1
patterns.notes: Korean pattern, page 2 of 3. 다리에 짧은뜨기 = sc into the post/leg of the dc; 사슬코부분 = into the chain space; 무늬중앙 = center of the motif. Rounds alternate 8-dc fan shells with ch-5 net mesh to build the lacy hat body.

patterns.englishText:
Coll Crochet Net Hat — Crown Rounds 12-20 & Ties

Rnd 12: *(dc, ch 3, sc in post of dc) 7 times, dc, sc in ch-space*, rep 6 times; (dc, ch 3, sc in post of dc) 7 times, dc, sl st into previous dc to join
Rnds 13-19 (7 rounds total): Repeat the sequence of Rnds 9 through 12 in order, continuing the fan-and-net pattern down the hat
Rnd 20: *(dc, ch 3, sc in post of dc) 7 times, dc, sc in ch-space*, rep 2 times; (dc, ch 3, sc in post of dc) 7 times, dc, sl st into center of ch-space; ch 90, ch 2 (turning ch), 90 dc back along the chain, sl st — makes the first tie
Finishing tie: *(dc, ch 3, sc in post of dc) 7 times, dc, sc in ch-space*, rep 3 times; (dc, ch 3, sc in post of dc) 7 times, dc, sl st into previous dc; ch 90, ch 2 (turning ch), 90 dc back along the chain, sl st — makes the second tie
patterns.chineseText:
12단: [(한길긴뜨기1, 사슬3, 한길긴뜨기 다리에 짧은뜨기1)X7번 반복, 한길긴뜨기1, (사슬코부분에)짧은뜨기1]X6번 반복, (한길긴뜨기1, 사슬3, 한길긴뜨기 다리에 짧은뜨기1)X7번 반복, 한길긴뜨기1, (전단 한길긴뜨기코에)빼뜨기
13단~19단(총7단): 9번째단부터 12번째단까지 순서대로 반복
20단: [(한길긴뜨기1, 사슬3, 한길긴뜨기 다리에 짧은뜨기1)X7번 반복, 한길긴뜨기1, (사슬코부분에)짧은뜨기1]X2번 반복, (한길긴뜨기1, 사슬3, 한길긴뜨기 다리에 짧은뜨기1)X7번 반복, 한길긴뜨기1, (사슬코중앙에)빼뜨기, 사슬90코, 사슬2코(기둥코), 긴뜨기90, 빼뜨기
마무리: [(한길긴뜨기1, 사슬3, 한길긴뜨기 다리에 짧은뜨기1)X7번 반복, 한길긴뜨기1, (사슬코부분에)짧은뜨기1]X3번 반복, (한길긴뜨기1, 사슬3, 한길긴뜨기 다리에 짧은뜨기1)X7번 반복, 한길긴뜨기1, (전단 한길긴뜨기코에)빼뜨기, 사슬90코, 사슬2코(기둥코), 긴뜨기90, 빼뜨기
patterns.notes: Korean pattern, page 3 of 3. Two ch-90 ties (each reinforced with a row of 90 dc) are added at the brim. Rnds 13-19 simply repeat the Rnd 9-12 block to lengthen the hat.

meta.intro: This Coll net hat is a lacy openwork hat worked from a doily-style crown in the round, alternating dc fan shells with chain-mesh arches down the body. It finishes with two long chain ties at the brim for a soft, romantic look.

faq.question: How does the lacy net effect form?
faq.answer: The net effect comes from the ch-1 and ch-3 (and later ch-5) spaces worked between the dc groups. As the crown grows, 7- and 8-dc fan shells alternate with chain-mesh arches to create the openwork.

faq.question: How do I lengthen the body of the hat?
faq.answer: Rounds 13 through 19 simply repeat the Round 9-12 block in order, continuing the fan-and-net pattern straight down. Work more repeats of that block if you want a longer hat.

faq.question: How are the ties made?
faq.answer: At Round 20 and the finishing round, each tie is a ch 90 plus a turning ch, then 90 dc worked back along the chain and a sl st. This reinforces each ch-90 tie with a full row of dc so the ties hold their shape.

faq.question: The chart uses Korean terms. What do they mean?
faq.answer: Key terms: 단 = round, 한길긴뜨기 = dc, 짧은뜨기 = sc, 사슬 = ch, 빼뜨기 = sl st, 매직링 = magic ring, and 기둥코/코수포함 = the turning chain counts as a stitch. Cross-check the symbol chart's stitch counts against the written rounds as you go.

title: Misty-Blue Star Headband
description:
线材：@回归线 悸动 色号：74 钩针：2.0
感谢@琳可麻麻手工 的教程，整理了一份图解
#钩针图解 #发带 #发带钩织 #钩针发带 #钩织发带 #钩针小物 #发饰
author: 钩韵时光集

patterns.englishText:
Misty-Blue Star Headband — Puff-Stitch Lace

Yarn: fine mohair, dusty-blue. Hook: 2.0 mm. A puff-stitch band with an openwork star/diamond motif worked in the center.

Row 1: Ch 20, work into the 5th ch from hook: (4-loop puff, ch 2, puff), ch 12, ch 13, (4-loop puff, ch 2, puff), hdc.
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sl st into the eyelet between the puffs, (puff, ch 2, puff), ch 12, (puff, ch 2, puff), hdc.
Row 3: Repeat Row 2.
Row 4 (star motif): Ch 1, turn, sl st, (puff, ch 2, puff), ch 6, work a puff into the center ch of the ch-13 from Row 1, enclosing the chain bar above; ch 1, turn, insert into the ch-6 gap and draw up 6 incomplete sc, yarn over and join two at a time (decreasing); then *insert 6 incomplete sc into the next gap of the previous round, join two at a time* — repeat 3 times to form the star points; at the far end work (puff, ch 2, puff), hdc.
Row 5: Ch 1, turn, sl st into the eyelet between the puffs, (puff, ch 2, puff), ch 12, (puff, ch 2, puff), hdc.
Rows 6-7: Ch 1, turn, sl st into the eyelet between the puffs, (puff, ch 2, puff), ch 12, (puff, ch 2, puff), hdc.
Row 8 (star motif): Ch 1, turn, sl st, (puff, ch 2, puff), ch 6, work a puff into the top of the Row-4 square, enclosing the chain above; ch 1, turn, and complete the star square as in Row 4.
Repeat Rows 5-8 to the desired length.
Final repeat: work to the ch 6 and the puff round; after the puffs, do not work the square — instead ch 6 straight across to the other side, (puff, ch 2, puff), hdc.

Ending / ties
End Row 1: Ch 1, turn, sl st, (puff, ch 2, puff), and on the other side (puff, ch 2, puff), hdc.
End Row 2: Ch 1, turn, sl st, work incomplete puffs into the eyelets on each side and join them together; without cutting, ch 65 for a tie cord. Finish the other side the same way.
patterns.chineseText: 雾蓝星织发带。R1：20ch倒5钩（4T的泡芙针，2ch，泡芙针），12ch，k13，（4T的泡芙针，2ch，泡芙针），F。R2：1ch翻转引拔到泡芙针之间的洞眼，（泡芙针，2ch，泡芙针），12ch，（泡芙针，2ch，泡芙针），F。R3：重复R2。R4：1ch翻转引拔，（泡芙针，2ch，泡芙针），6ch，在R1的13ch最中间的锁针上钩泡芙针，钩的时候包住上方锁针链，1ch，翻转，在6ch的缝隙穿入6次未完成短针，依次两两退针（再在上一圈的缝隙穿入6次未完成短针，两两退针）重复3次，在另一端钩（泡芙针，2ch，泡芙针），F。R5：1ch翻转引拔到泡芙针之间的洞眼，（泡芙针，2ch，泡芙针），12ch，（泡芙针，2ch，泡芙针），F。R6-7：1ch翻转引拔到泡芙针之间的洞眼，（泡芙针，2ch，泡芙针），12ch，（泡芙针，2ch，泡芙针），F。R8：1ch翻转引拔，（泡芙针，2ch，泡芙针），6ch，在R4的方格顶端钩泡芙针，钩的时候包住上方锁针链，1ch翻转，按R4步骤钩方格。接下去按R5-8重复至合适长度收尾。最后一组钩到6ch，泡芙针那一圈，钩完泡芙针不钩方格，直接继续钩6ch到另一侧钩（泡芙针，2ch，泡芙针），F。结尾。结尾R1：1ch翻转sl，（泡芙针，2ch，泡芙针），另一侧（泡芙针，2ch，泡芙针），F。结尾R2：1ch翻转sl，在两侧洞眼分别钩未完成泡芙针合并，不断线65ch作为绑绳，另一侧收尾用相同的方法。
patterns.notes: Hook: 2.0 mm. Yarn: dusty/misty-blue fine mohair. Puff stitch = 4 loops (4-loop puff). Open lace band built on a (puff, ch 2, puff) + ch-12 mesh, with star/diamond motifs worked at Rows 4 and 8 (and every 4th row). Repeat the 4-row block to the wearer's head length. Each end is gathered and finished with a ch-65 tie.

meta.intro: This misty-blue star headband is a delicate puff-stitch lace band worked in fine dusty-blue mohair, with openwork star/diamond motifs set into the center. The repeating 4-row block lets you make it any length, finished with gathered ends and tie cords.

faq.question: What is the puff stitch in this pattern?
faq.answer: The puff stitch here is a 4-loop puff, meaning you draw up loops until you have 4 on the hook before closing. The whole band is built on a repeating (puff, ch 2, puff) plus ch-12 mesh framework.

faq.question: How do I make the headband longer or shorter?
faq.answer: Repeat the 4-row block (the star motif falls on every 4th row, at Rows 4, 8, and so on) until the band reaches your head length. On the final repeat, don't work the square: ch 6 straight across, then finish with the ending rows and tie.

faq.question: How are the ends finished?
faq.answer: Each end is gathered by working incomplete puffs into the eyelets on both sides and joining them together, then without cutting the yarn, ch 65 for a tie cord. Repeat on the other side so both ends have ties.

faq.question: Why such a fine hook and yarn?
faq.answer: The 2.0 mm hook and fine dusty-blue mohair keep the puff-stitch lace airy and delicate. Mohair's soft halo also helps blend the openwork star motifs into the band.

title: Strawberry Triangle Shawl
description:
针号：3号 纯白色棉线
原图解增加到8个花，钩好蒸汽烫一下、垂感更好
#钩针蕾丝 #爱生活爱编织 #针织手作 #钩针图解 #图解分享 #编织
author: 糖果

patterns.englishText:
Strawberry Triangle Shawl — Openwork Lace with Fan Edging

Worked from the bottom point upward, increasing in width. Hook: size 3 (≈3.0 mm), pure white cotton.

Legend (from chart): o = ch, + = sc, T = dc, fan symbol = 3-dc increase (3 dc in one st).

Pattern
Begin at the bottom point (△ start) with a small group of dc.
The body is a repeating openwork lace: vertical columns of dc separated by ch arches, with 3-dc fans worked across the rows. Each row adds a unit of (dc columns + ch mesh + 3-dc fan), and the triangle widens by one motif each row.
Main repeat (read the chart row by row):
- Work columns of dc with ch-loops between them.
- Where the chart shows the fan symbol, work 3 dc in one stitch (the 3-dc fan) to form the scalloped lace.
- Continue the established pattern upward, adding a motif each row, until the shawl reaches the desired length.

Finishing
After the lace body is done, work one round of sc all around the edges.
Then add the fan edging: along the lower two sides work a border of 3-dc fans (as shown at the bottom of the chart) for a scalloped lace trim.
patterns.chineseText: 钩针草莓三角巾图解（符号图）。符号说明：o锁针/辫子针，十短针，T长针，长针3加针（3-dc fan）。三角形从顶点△起点起，向上扩大。基础为长针纵列+锁针拱桥的镂空花样，每个花样单元由长针、锁针网格和3长针加针扇形组成，按规律往上钩织直到合适长度。钩完花样后钩一圈短针，然后钩花边（3长针加针的扇形边）。
patterns.notes: Hook: size 3 (~3.0 mm). Yarn: pure white cotton. Triangular shawl worked top-down from the point. Symbol chart legend: o = ch, + = sc, T = dc, the fan symbol = 3 dc in one st (3-dc fan). The Chinese maker enlarged the original to 8 motif repeats and steam-blocked it for better drape. Counts per row are not individually labeled — follow the chart visually; the repeat is dc columns + ch mesh + 3-dc fans, widening one motif per row.

meta.intro: A triangular openwork lace shawl worked top-down from a single bottom point, widening row by row into a delicate mesh of double-crochet columns. Finished with a scalloped 3-dc fan edging, it makes an airy, elegant wrap.

faq.question: What hook and yarn does this shawl use?
faq.answer: A size 3 hook (about 3.0 mm) with pure white cotton yarn, which gives the lace good stitch definition.

faq.question: How is the triangle shaped?
faq.answer: It's worked from the bottom point upward, adding one motif (a unit of dc columns, ch mesh, and a 3-dc fan) per row so the triangle widens as you go.

faq.question: How do I make it larger?
faq.answer: Keep adding motif repeats per row until you reach the length you want. The maker enlarged the original to 8 motif repeats for a bigger wrap.

faq.question: Do I need to block it?
faq.answer: Yes, blocking is recommended. The maker steam-blocked the finished shawl to open up the lace and improve the drape.

title: Sunglasses Pouch
description:
前几天逛ig刷到的一个韩国博主的墨镜收纳，觉得很简约耐看（图解在最后）。之后又刷到图解教程，就自己试着翻译来钩织啦，对新手或者手残党都很友好，都是长针和加针的结合。原图解博主ig：cokorenbilir
#织女日常 #墨镜收纳 #钩针图解
author: 唔准咪摸

patterns.englishText:
Sunglasses Pouch — Round Base

Work in continuous rounds, joining each round with a sl st.

Rnd 1: 12 dc in MR, join (12)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (24)
Rnd 3: *1 dc, inc*, repeat around (36)
Rnd 4: *2 dc, inc*, repeat around (48)
Rnd 5: 48 reverse sc around (48)

Fasten off and weave in ends.
patterns.chineseText:
🕶️墨镜收纳套
圈1：环起12个长针（每一圈都需要引拔）
圈2：每针加针×12次 （24针）
圈3：1个长针，1加针×12次 （36针）
圈4：2个长针，1加针×12次 （48针）
圈5：48个反短针
断线藏线完成✅
用针：6.0钩针
patterns.notes: Hook: 6.0 mm. Beginner-friendly — only double crochet and increases. Every round is joined with a slip stitch. Add a hanging cord/strap to wear it as a sunglasses holder.

meta.intro: A simple round pouch designed to hold and protect sunglasses, made from quick double-crochet rounds and finished with a decorative reverse single crochet edge. Add a cord and it becomes a wearable sunglasses holder.

faq.question: Is this beginner-friendly?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses only double crochet and increases worked in joined rounds, making it a great first project.

faq.question: What is the reverse sc round in Rnd 5 for?
faq.answer: The final round of reverse single crochet (crab stitch) creates a neat, corded decorative edge around the opening.

faq.question: How do I wear it as a holder?
faq.answer: Attach a hanging cord or strap to the pouch so it can be worn or clipped, letting you carry your sunglasses hands-free.

faq.question: How are the rounds joined?
faq.answer: Every round is worked and then joined with a slip stitch to the first stitch before starting the next round.

title: Granny Square Motif No. 375
description:
线材：@苏苏姐家 四股 色号：70/06/89/95 钩针：2.5
#花片钩织 #花片 #钩针花片 #钩针祖母格 #祖母格花片 #钩针图解 #杯垫 #钩针杯垫
author: 芸里手作

patterns.englishText:
Granny Square Motif No. 375 — Floral Square

Work in joined rounds; join each round with a sl st to the first stitch.

Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR, join (8)
Rnd 2: Ch 3 (counts as dc), dc in same st, *2 dc in next st*, repeat around, join (16)
Rnd 3: Ch 1, *sc in next st, ch 3, skip 1 st*, repeat around, join (8 sc, 8 ch-3 arches)
Rnd 4: Sl st into ch-3 arch, ch 3, (2 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in same arch for corner, *3 dc in next arch, (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in next arch*, repeat to form 4 corners, join
Rnd 5: Ch 3, dc in each dc, work (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in each ch-2 corner space, ch 3 arches across the sides between dc groups, join
Rnd 6: Edge round — *fan of dc along each side, ch 3 arches between*, and at each corner work a 3-petal bud cluster: (puff/dc-cluster, ch 3, puff/dc-cluster) forming the pointed petal tips, repeat around, join

Fasten off and weave in ends.
patterns.chineseText: 花片No.375 符号图解：中心环起，向外为长针扇形、锁针弧线，四角放射，外圈花苞/水滴形花瓣群（V形长针簇）。线材四股，钩针2.5。
patterns.notes: Yarn: 4-ply cotton (colorway 70 / 06 / 89 / 95). Hook: 2.5 mm. Finished as a square floral motif suitable for a coaster. Read the chart from the center outward; corners are marked by the ch-2 spaces, and the outer round ends in pointed bud/petal clusters at each side and corner.

meta.intro: A square floral granny-square motif that builds from a center ring out to pointed bud-and-petal clusters at the corners and sides. Worked in joined rounds, it makes a pretty standalone coaster or a building block for larger projects.

faq.question: What yarn and hook are recommended?
faq.answer: 4-ply cotton (the maker used colorways 70, 06, 89, and 95) with a 2.5 mm hook.

faq.question: How do I find the corners while working?
faq.answer: The corners are marked by the ch-2 spaces. Work the corner clusters into those ch-2 spaces on each round to keep the square shape.

faq.question: What can I make with this motif?
faq.answer: It's finished as a square floral motif that works well as a coaster, and it can also be joined with others as a granny square.

faq.question: How should I read the pattern?
faq.answer: Read the chart from the center outward, round by round, ending with the pointed bud/petal clusters at each side and corner on the final edge round.

title: Crochet Earth Globe
description:
拯救计划同款的钩针地球终于完成了！赶工到半夜，结果发现图解错误，崩溃。为了不让大家走弯路，我把整个图解从头到尾仔细检查、校对，并用"J人精神"重新整理了一个超清晰Excel版本，图形颜色、针目增减、换色提示都标注了。
#钩针图解 #拯救计划 #钩针地球 #J人本性
author: SagittariusWW

patterns.englishText:
Crochet Earth Globe — Sphere Colorwork

Basic sphere shape (work colors per the chart: blue = ocean, green = land, yellow accents):
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *sc, inc*, repeat around (18)
Rnd 4: *sc, inc, sc*, repeat around (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc*, repeat around (30)
Rnd 6: *4 sc, inc*, repeat around (36)
Rnd 7: *5 sc, inc*, repeat around (42)
Rnd 8: *6 sc, inc*, repeat around (48)
Rnd 9-18: sc in each st around (48), changing colors per the chart
Rnd 19: *6 sc, dec*, repeat around (42)
Rnd 20: *5 sc, dec*, repeat around (36)
Rnd 21: *4 sc, dec*, repeat around (30)
Rnd 22: *3 sc, dec*, repeat around (24)
Rnd 23: *2 sc, dec*, repeat around (18)
Rnd 24: *sc, dec*, repeat around (12)
Rnd 25: dec around (6)
Rnd 26: close off remaining stitches
patterns.chineseText: 钩针地球(球体配色图)。48 列网格,X=短针,V=加针,A=减针,右侧针数/圈数列:R1:6 R2:12 R3:18 R4:24 R5:30 R6:36 R7:42 R8:48 R9-R18:48 R19:42 R20:36 R21:30 R22:24 R23:18 R24:12 R25:6 R26:收口。绿/蓝/黄换色按格子配色(陆地绿、海洋蓝)。
patterns.notes: Colorwork sphere chart (rebuilt in Excel): X = sc, V = inc, A = dec; the rightmost column gives round numbers and running stitch counts (peaks at 48 sts for Rnds 8-18). Change yarn color per the grid to form continents (green) over ocean (blue). Stuff before closing. Increase/decrease distribution is even per a standard amigurumi sphere; follow the grid for exact stitch placement.

meta.intro: A stuffed crochet Earth globe worked as a colorwork amigurumi sphere, with green continents over a blue ocean and yellow accents. It's a charming desk or shelf decoration.

faq.question: What colors do I need for the Earth?
faq.answer: Work the sphere in blue for the ocean, green for the land/continents, and yellow for accents, changing colors per the chart grid during Rnds 9-18 where the sphere is at its full 48 stitches.

faq.question: How do I place the continents accurately?
faq.answer: The increases and decreases are distributed evenly like a standard amigurumi sphere, but follow the colorwork grid for exact stitch placement so the green continents land correctly over the blue ocean.

faq.question: When should I stuff the globe?
faq.answer: Stuff the sphere with fiberfill before closing it off at the final decrease rounds (around Rnd 25-26) so it holds a round shape.

faq.question: How do I read the chart symbols?
faq.answer: On the rebuilt grid chart, X = sc, V = inc, and A = dec. The rightmost column gives the round number and running stitch count, which peaks at 48 stitches for Rnds 8-18.

title: Lace Polo Shirt
description:
"夏日的清凉感，藏在这件手工蕾丝Polo里了"
钩针：3.5 线材：6号蕾丝线（新米黄）重量：约310克
图解：原图解也是3.5的钩针，6号蕾丝线比原版更细需加针目。1、片钩前后身片，分别起130针，从下往上钩，侧身共34行(32cm)，袖口共22行(21cm)。
#钩针polo衫 #蕾丝衫 #钩针图解
author: MOOTOO

patterns.englishText:
Lace Polo Shirt — Schematic & Assembly (Sizes 24 / 25)

This page is the garment schematic (measurement diagram), not a stitch-by-stitch chart.

Back Body:
- Cast on 52 cm (100 sts) at the lower edge with a foundation double-chain.
- Shoulders: 16 cm (31 sts) each side + back neck 20 cm (38 sts) across the top.
- Work pattern stitch in dc-mesh with a 6/0 (3.5 mm) hook.
- Length: 20 cm (16 rows) at the upper section; final row joins to the front body.
- Armhole / side: Size 24 = 35 cm (28 rows); Size 25 = 27.5 cm (22 rows).

Front Body:
- Cast on 52 cm (100 sts), foundation double-chain.
- Neckline divided 8 cm / 4 cm / 8 cm across the top (15 sts / 15 sts / 31 sts side panels).
- Front neck opening 5 cm (4 rows) deep, neck width 14 cm (11 sts).

Sleeve:
- Pick up 40 cm (76 sts).
- Length: Size 24 = 18.5 cm (15 rows); Size 25 = 11.5 cm (9 rows).
- Final row finished with sl st (join row).

Gauge: 19 sts x 8 rows = 10 cm square in pattern stitch.

Assembly:
- Collar & left front band: pick up 93 sts total (43 sts from back, 1 st per row up the front), work edging in 6/0 (3.5 mm) hook; collar 6.5 cm (16 rows).
- Right front band: pick up 35 sts up the front, work edging; band 3.5 cm (8 rows). Work buttonholes on the right band.
- Join with finishing slip-stitch seam: work the front bands and collar in order, attaching the front band edge to the body with sl st.
- Sew on 3 buttons (18 mm).

Construction notes:
- Crochet the front and back bodies first in pattern stitch, joining at the shoulders.
- Pick up sleeve stitches from the body and work the sleeve in pattern, finishing with sl st.
- Work the collar edging, then bands.
- Seam underarms and sleeves with chain + sl st.
patterns.chineseText: （日文图书图解，第26·27页，款式24·25）使用线：钻石毛线 Diacostal[合太型] 24号米黄(CSU516)315g(9玉)；25号(CSU523)270g(8玉)。用具：钻石毛线特制钩针6/0号。附属品：纽扣(18mm)3个。成品尺寸：着丈24=55cm，25=47.5cm；胸围104cm，袖丈24=44.5cm，25=37.5cm。后身片：宽52c(100目)起，左右各16c(31目)+20c(38目)+16c(31目)，1c(2段)，编20c(16段)，最终段与前身片连接，袖24=35c(28段)/25=27.5c(22段)。前身片：52c(100目)起，领口8c4c8c分布，5c(4段)开领，14c(11目)领宽。袖：起40c(76目)，编24=18.5c(15段)/25=11.5c(9段)。规格(10cm见方)花样编 19目8段。衣领·左前立、右前立用边编6/0号钩针，仕上引拔编连接。
patterns.notes: Hook: 6/0 Japanese (3.5 mm). The maker's note (from post): she used a finer No. 6 lace thread (about 310 g, ~natural beige) so she added stitches vs. the original; original chart also used a 3.5 mm hook. Front and back panels worked flat separately, each cast on 130 sts, worked bottom-up; side body 34 rows (32 cm), sleeve cuff 22 rows (21 cm). Buttons: three 18 mm. This image is a Japanese pattern-book schematic page (sizes 24 & 25); measurements are given for both. Stitch counts in this translation are converted from the Japanese 目(sts)/段(rows) notation.

patterns.englishText:
Lace Polo Shirt — Body & Sleeve Pattern Chart

This is the symbol stitch chart for the openwork pattern used on the body and sleeves. The repeat is a 3-stitch fan/V-stitch mesh worked in double crochet.

Body pattern (front & back):
Foundation: double-chain foundation (foundation row), 100 sts wide, centered.
Row 1: Work into the foundation, establishing the mesh base.
Pattern repeat (3 sts = 1 repeat) worked over ~15 rows:
*Skip sts, work a V-group of dc (2 dc, ch, 2 dc or fan) into the mesh space, ch between groups*, repeat across, staggering groups each row to form the diamond mesh.
Rows continue the same V-stitch / fan repeat to row 15.

Sleeve pattern:
Same openwork repeat (3 sts = 1 repeat), 76 sts wide, centered on the shoulder line.
Work the identical V-stitch/fan mesh up to row 15.
Final row (row 15): sl st across (join row) - common to sizes 24 and 25.
patterns.chineseText: （日文图解符号图）前后身片的花样编（模様編み）：长针的网格花样，约15行，每隔几针有V形长针组，底部为锁针起针（スレッドの二重鎖編み，双重锁针起针），100目宽，中央对齐，3目1花样。袖的编织图（袖の編み方図）：同样花样编，约15行，76目宽，中央(肩線)对齐，3目1花样，顶部第15行引拔编（24·25共通）。
patterns.notes: Hook: 6/0 (3.5 mm). This image is a symbol stitch chart showing the openwork V-stitch (fan) mesh pattern. The repeat is a 3-stitch unit; rows of paired dc groups separated by chain spaces create the diamond lace. Same pattern is used for both the body panels and the sleeves; sizes 24 and 25 share the stitch pattern and differ only in row count (see schematic page).

patterns.englishText:
Lace Polo Shirt — Yoke, Armhole & Neckline Shaping Chart

This chart shows the upper body (yoke) of the pattern with armhole and neckline shaping, in the same dc V-stitch / fan mesh (3 sts = 1 repeat).

Work the V-stitch mesh up from the lower body. At the armhole edges, decrease/leave stitches unworked to shape the armholes (step back at the start of the indicated rows).

Neckline:
At the center front, divide for the V/round neck. Decrease along the neck edge in a curve - skip or work fewer fan groups at the neck edge on each successive row to round the opening.
Continue the fan mesh up each shoulder over ~13 rows to the shoulder seam.
Finish neck and armhole edges along the indicated decrease lines.
patterns.chineseText: （日文图解符号图）前后身片(2)的编织方法图·身的使用方法·领的减针法：长针V形网格花样，左右肩部及领口处做减针/留针，袖窿处收针，领口为弧形减针，3目1花样，约13行高。
patterns.notes: Hook: 6/0 (3.5 mm). This image is a symbol stitch chart for the upper body / yoke, showing how the openwork fan mesh is decreased at the armholes and shaped around the front neckline. Same 3-stitch fan repeat as the main body chart. Use this chart together with the schematic page for stitch and row counts.

patterns.englishText:
Lace Polo Shirt — Edgings & Finishing Reference

Stitch glossary (top of page):
- Chain stitch (ch) and the back bump (back ridge) of the chain.
- Single crochet (sc) - shown in figure 5.
- Double crochet (dc) - shown in figure 6.

Chain + slip-stitch seam (joining two pieces):
Hold the two pieces right sides together. Work a chain, then insert the hook through both layers as indicated by the arrows and join the two pieces with slip stitch.

Collar edging:
Pick up 33 sts. Work the square/filet mesh pattern (2 sts = 1 repeat) for 16 rows. At each corner, add 1 stitch (work 1 extra st into the corner).

Left front band edging:
Work the filet mesh pattern for 8 rows. ● marks button positions.

Right front band edging:
Work the filet mesh pattern for 8 rows. Make buttonholes (ch-space openings) at the marked positions; join/continue from the body at the indicated pick-up line.

Slip-stitch join method:
The lower diagrams show how the left and right front bands are joined to the body with slip stitch (work sl st along the band, attaching to the body edge).
patterns.chineseText: （日文图解）目的数え方と名称（针目的数法与名称）：锁针目、锁的里山、细编目(短针,5图)、长编目(长针,6图)的图示。锁编みと引き抜き编みとじ（锁针与引拔针缝合）：中表对齐，钩锁针，按箭头方向入针，两片一起引拔。衣领的边编（衿の縁編み）：方眼/网格花样，33目拾，16行，2目1花样，角处每边加1目。左前立的边编（左前立ての縁編み）：网格花样，●=纽扣位置，8行。右前立的边编（右前立ての縁編み）：网格花样，纽扣孔，从身片引拔接续位置，8行。引拔编的编织方法（引き抜き编みの编み方）：图示左前立、右前立的引拔编。
patterns.notes: Hook: 6/0 (3.5 mm). This image is the finishing/reference page of the Japanese pattern book: a stitch glossary (ch, sc, dc), a chain + slip-stitch seaming method, and the filet-mesh edging charts for the collar and the left/right front bands. The collar edging is 16 rows, the front bands are 8 rows each; buttonholes are placed on the right band to match the 3 buttons. Use with the schematic and pattern charts.

meta.intro: A crisp white lace polo shirt worked flat in an openwork V-stitch fan mesh, finished with a collar, buttoned front bands, and set-in sleeves. The fine cotton gives it a fresh, summery feel.
materials: #6 fine lace thread (about 310 g, natural beige in the maker's version)

faq.question: What hook and yarn does this polo use?
faq.answer: The original pattern uses a 6/0 Japanese (3.5 mm) hook. The maker used a finer No. 6 lace thread (about 310 g, natural beige) and added stitches to compensate, but kept the same 3.5 mm hook.

faq.question: What is the gauge and how do I check sizing?
faq.answer: Gauge is 19 stitches x 8 rows = 10 cm square in the pattern stitch. The schematic gives measurements for sizes 24 and 25, which share the same stitch pattern and differ only in row count (for example side body 35 cm/28 rows for size 24 versus 27.5 cm/22 rows for size 25).

faq.question: How is the polo assembled?
faq.answer: Crochet the front and back bodies flat in pattern and join at the shoulders, then pick up and work the sleeves in pattern. Work the collar edging (pick up 93 sts, about 6.5 cm/16 rows) and the front bands, adding buttonholes on the right band, and finally seam the underarms and sleeves with chain and slip stitch.

faq.question: How many buttons does it take?
faq.answer: Sew on three 18 mm buttons along the front band, with matching buttonholes worked into the right front band.

title: Zongzi Dumpling Bag
description:
苏苏姐家四股棉411#。绿野仙踪到底织什么好看啊，织了拆拆了织，终于灵机一动做了一个粽子包，好可爱！P3自制图解，视频教程参考附在评论区，手慢的织女可以开始为端午节做准备了。
#钩针教程 #粽子包 #绿野仙踪 #钩针图解
author: 咖布西耶

patterns.englishText:
Zongzi Dumpling Bag — Net-Stitch Body & Flap

Yarn: 4-ply cotton, sport weight. Hook: 3.0 mm. Worked in a green-gradient colorway (darker green for the body, lighter for the flap).

Body (darker section)
Foundation: Ch 40, join with sl st into a ring (mind the direction — don't twist the chain inside-out).
Rnd 1: Ch 1 (does not count as st), 40 sc worked into both the back bump and half-stitch of the foundation, join with sl st (40).
Rnd 2: Ch 1 (does not count), 40 sc (40).
Rnd 3: *Sc, drop-down sc* 20 times — work each drop-down sc into the stitch leg of the previous round (40).
Rnd 4: Ch 1, turn. *Sc, drop-down sc pulling up through the two adjacent vertical bars* 20 times (40).
Rnd 5: *Drop-down sc, sc* 20 times — insert for the drop-down sc between the two strands at the point of the V (40).
Rnd 6: Ch 1, turn. *Sc, drop-down sc pulling up through the two adjacent vertical bars* 20 times (40).
Repeat Rnds 5-6: every 2 rounds forms one row of the net pattern. Work 13 net repeats (26 rounds), for a total body height of 28 rounds. Keep 40 sts every round. Fasten off.

Flap (lighter section)
Starting at any st of the body, work 20 sc.
Work flat for about 20 rows (the flap, once seamed, should just cover the bottom edge of the body — adjust the number of rows as needed).
Edging: sc once around all three sides.

Assembly
Fold the flap in half and whipstitch closed, leaving a 1-st gap to thread the drawstring through. Fold the body and whipstitch.
Drawstring: ch 120 or more (a longer cord keeps the flap from opening fully). Thread it through the flap, wrap, and knot to secure.
patterns.chineseText: 粽子包文字图解。粽子主体（深色段）：起40ch首尾引拔（注意方向，辫子针不要里外接反了）。R1：起立一个锁针（不计数），排半个鱼骨+里山共计40X，首尾引拔。R2：起立一个锁针（不计数），40X。R3：20(X,下拉X)（下拉X针入针处为前一圈针脚）。R4：起立一锁针，翻转，20(X，穿过相邻两根竖线下拉钩一个X)。R5：20(下拉X，X)（下拉X短针的出针点位于V字尖角两根线中间）。R6：起立一锁针，翻转，20(X，穿过相邻两根竖线下拉钩一短针)。重复R5-R6，每2圈构成1组渔网花样，共需钩织13组（26圈）渔网层，最终包身达28圈包高；如果严格保持每圈40针，断线收尾，包身主体完工。包盖（浅色段）：包身任一针开始钩20X。片钩约20排左右（织到包盖缝合后刚好盖住包身的底边，排数可根据情况增减）。沿着三边织一圈短针。缝合：包盖对折卷线缝合，空1针穿绳，包身对折卷线缝合。背绳>120ch（大短包盖无法完全打开，穿过包盖包裹线后打结固定）。
patterns.notes: Hook: 3.0 mm. Yarn: 4-ply sport-weight cotton, green gradient colorway (dark green body, light green flap). Body = 28 rounds tall (40 sts each), built from 13 repeats of a drop-down-sc net pattern. Flap worked flat ~20 rows then seamed. Drawstring 120+ ch.

meta.intro: A zongzi-style drawstring bag worked in a textured drop-down net stitch, shown in a green-gradient colorway with a contrasting flap. Its dumpling-like shape makes it a fun, eye-catching little pouch.
materials: 4-ply sport-weight cotton, green gradient colorway (dark green body, light green flap)

faq.question: What yarn and hook should I use?
faq.answer: Use 4-ply sport-weight cotton with a 3.0 mm hook. The sample uses a green gradient colorway with a darker green body and a lighter green flap.

faq.question: How tall is the body and how is the net pattern built?
faq.answer: The body is 28 rounds tall, keeping 40 stitches every round, and is built from 13 repeats of the drop-down sc net pattern (Rnds 5-6 repeated, two rounds per net row).

faq.question: How do I work the drop-down net stitch?
faq.answer: Alternate a regular sc with a drop-down sc, working the drop-down stitch into the stitch leg of the previous round (insert between the two strands at the point of the V) and pulling up through the two adjacent vertical bars. This staggered insertion creates the net texture.

faq.question: How is the bag assembled and how long should the drawstring be?
faq.answer: Fold the flap in half and whipstitch it closed, leaving a 1-stitch gap for the drawstring, then fold and whipstitch the body. Make the drawstring 120+ chains; a longer cord keeps the flap from opening fully.

title: Hexagon Star Mesh Tote
description:
被这缕亮黄治愈了✨ 明亮又有活力💖 简简单单的编织，满满都是生命力🍋
【附图解】🪡钩针：3.5mm 🧶线材：棉草线嫩黄色50g3团单股钩（共用约127g）
#钩针编织 #手工钩织 #钩针包包 #针织手作
author: xuuu_素咦ya

patterns.englishText:
Hexagon Star Mesh Tote — Openwork Net Body & Straps

Yarn: tape/raffia cotton, light yellow, 50 g x 3 skeins (~127 g used), worked single strand. Hook: 3.5 mm.

Foundation: Ch 57, plus 1 turning ch (ch 58 total).

Body — net / mesh ground
Work the lower body in an openwork net pattern: rows of sc joined by ch spaces forming a diagonal trellis (each sc anchored into the ch space of the previous row, with ch bars between). Continue the mesh for the depth of the bag, keeping the net repeat consistent across all 57 working stitches.

Star band
Near the top, work a band of six-pointed star (hexagon) motifs: clusters of dc radiating into points separated by ch loops, set across the top of the mesh ground to form the row of stars.

Straps
The two top straps taper in from the body: decrease the stitch count at each side over about 20 rows per strap until the strap reaches full length, then join/seam the strap ends to form the shoulder handle.
patterns.chineseText: 六角星芒镂空包包钩织图解（符号图）。起57+1ch。包带部份共20排。底部为锁针起针的渔网/方眼基础，中间为短针+锁针组成的镂空网格层，上方一圈六角星芒花样，包带两侧收窄片钩约20排。
patterns.notes: Hook: 3.5 mm. Yarn: light-yellow tape/raffia cotton, single strand, ~127 g total (3 x 50 g skeins). Symbol chart: ch 57+1 foundation, openwork net/mesh body, a band of six-pointed star motifs near the top, two tapering straps (~20 rows each). Chart symbols are small; stitch counts per net repeat are not individually legible, so follow the chart visually for the trellis spacing.

meta.intro: This airy hexagon star mesh tote is worked in a light-yellow tape/raffia cotton with an openwork net body and a band of six-pointed star motifs near the top. The breezy trellis pattern and tapered shoulder straps make it a perfect lightweight summer market bag.
materials: Tape/raffia cotton yarn, light yellow, 3 x 50 g skeins (~127 g used)

faq.question: How much yarn do I need for this tote?
faq.answer: The sample uses about 127 g of light-yellow tape/raffia cotton, worked single strand, which is roughly three 50 g skeins. Buy three skeins to be safe, since net patterns and strap length can vary the total.

faq.question: What hook size should I use?
faq.answer: Use a 3.5 mm hook with the single-strand tape/raffia cotton, as specified in the pattern. A slightly larger hook will open up the mesh further if you want an even airier look.

faq.question: How many stitches should each net repeat have?
faq.answer: The symbol chart's stitch counts per net repeat aren't individually legible, so follow the chart visually: start from the ch 57 (+1 turning ch) foundation and keep the trellis spacing of sc anchored into the previous row's ch spaces consistent across all 57 working stitches.

faq.question: How are the straps made?
faq.answer: The two top straps taper in from the body by decreasing the stitch count at each side over about 20 rows per strap. Once each strap reaches full length, join or seam the strap ends together to form the shoulder handle.

title: Star Pet Collar (Faux Bib)
description:
用线：@苏苏姐家 唯棉
色号：06乳白、14浅蓝、72空蓝、65奶黄、70鹅黄、09鸡黄
钩针：2.5mm 图解@星语手作 @钩韵时光集
#钩针图解 #猫咪围脖 #宠物项圈 #猫咪狗狗围兜 #假领子 #口水巾
author: 萌猫织织

patterns.englishText:
Star Pet Collar (Faux Bib) — Scalloped Layers with Star Charms

Worked in a multiples-of-6 repeat. Hook: 2.5 mm. Cotton in cream, light blue, sky blue, custard, goose-yellow, and chick-yellow.

Foundation (goose-yellow)
Rnd 1: Ch 55, work into the 4th ch from hook; *hdc, ch 2* 17 times across, end with 1 hdc (this sets the row of hdc with ch-2 spaces).

Body scallops
Rnd 2 (custard): Sc in the first dc, then work into the gaps between the hdc of the previous round — treating every two gaps as one unit, work (3 hdc, ch 3, 3 hdc) in one gap and sc in the next; after the last gap, sc directly into the last dc.
Rnd 3 (white): Sc, *(4 hdc, ch 3, 4 hdc) in the ch-3 space of the previous round, sc in the sc of the previous round*, repeat around.
Rnd 4 (sky blue): Sc in each sc; work FPdc around each dc/hdc post; in each ch-3 space work (3 hdc, ch 3, 3 hdc).
Rnd 5 (light blue): Sc around; in each ch-3 space work (2 sc, ch-3 picot, 2 sc).

Tie
Tie cord (chick-yellow): ch 150.

Star charms
In a magic ring, work 5 groups of (sc, ch 1, hdc, ch-2 picot, ch 1); join and pull closed to form a 5-point star. Attach to the collar.
patterns.chineseText: 星星宠物围脖（放大加6的倍数）。R1：(鹅黄)55ch倒4钩17组[Fw,k2]，循环，最后一针钩Fw。R2：(奶黄)第一个长针上钩x，接下去都钩在上一圈Fw和Fw之间的间隙，两个间隙为一个组合，分别钩(3F,3ch,3F)和x，最后一个间隙钩完后，直接在最后一个长针上钩x。R3：(白色)x,[在上一圈的3ch里钩(4F,3ch,4F)，上一圈的x上钩x]，循环。R4：(水蓝)x上继续钩x,所有长针上钩内钩长针,3ch洞眼钩(3F,3ch,3F)。R5：(空蓝)钩一圈短针，其中3ch洞眼钩(2x,3ch狗牙,2x)。绑绳：(鸡黄)150ch。星星：环起5组(x,1ch,F,2ch狗牙,1ch)。
patterns.notes: Hook: 2.5 mm. Cotton in 6 colors (cream, light blue, sky blue, custard, goose-yellow, chick-yellow). Sized in multiples of 6 — adjust foundation chain to fit. Layered scalloped 'faux bib' collar with FPdc texture round; finished with a ch-150 tie and small 5-point star charms. (Source chart uses 'Fw' for hdc and 'F' for hdc, 'k2' for ch 2.)

meta.intro: This star pet collar is a layered, scalloped faux bib worked in six soft cotton colors with a front-post-textured round and dainty 5-point star charms. Finished with a long tie cord, it dresses up a pet (or doll) with a sweet, ruffly collar.
materials: Cotton yarn in 6 colors: cream, light blue, sky blue, custard, goose-yellow, chick-yellow

faq.question: How do I resize the collar to fit my pet?
faq.answer: The collar is worked in multiples of 6, so adjust the foundation chain up or down in increments of 6 stitches to fit your pet's neck before working the scalloped rounds.

faq.question: What is the FPdc round for?
faq.answer: Round 4 (sky blue) works a front-post double crochet (FPdc) around each dc/hdc post. This adds raised texture and definition between the scalloped layers so the bib stands out instead of lying flat.

faq.question: How are the star charms made and attached?
faq.answer: Each star is worked in a magic ring as 5 groups of (sc, ch 1, hdc, ch-2 picot, ch 1), then joined and pulled closed to form the 5 points. Sew the finished stars onto the collar wherever you like.

faq.question: The chart uses unusual symbols. What do they mean?
faq.answer: The source chart uses 'Fw' and 'F' for hdc and 'k2' for ch 2. Read those as half double crochet and chain-2 respectively when following the diagram.

title: Grogu Doll
description:
The cutest baby in the universe. 藏不住了其实我是超级星战粉。超鸡冻！明天就要去看《曼达洛人与古古》啦。火速钩了一个迷你公仔，图解来自ig：onpoki，感觉这是我见过的最好看的版本，翻译整理的图解在最后一张图片。衣领是3.5钩针，其余都是…
#Grogu #曼达洛人 #钩针玩偶 #图解
author: Summerain

patterns.englishText:
Grogu Doll — Arms, Ears, Head/Body & Collar

Worked amigurumi-style. Use safety beads/plastic eyes. Body in green, ears tipped light brown; collar in beige (hook 3.5 mm). Eyes: plastic beads recommended.

Arms (make 2)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (green) (6)
Rnd 2: *sc, inc* 3 times... actually *5 sc, inc* — work (5 sc, inc) (the row reads "5X V", i.e. some sc then an increase) (7)
Rnds 3-4: Change to light brown, 7 sc each round (7)
No stuffing. Flatten Rnd 4 and sc across through both layers: 3 sc to close. Leave a long tail to sew on.

Ears (make 2, green)
Left ear: Ch 8, work back to the 3rd ch: 4 tr, then (2 sc, sl st), sl st, 5 tr. Leave a long tail to sew.
Right ear: Ch 8, work back to the 3rd ch: 5 tr, sl st, (sl st, 2 sc), 4 tr, then 1 tr. Leave a long tail to sew.

Head/Body (worked as one piece, green)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc, sc, 2 inc, sc, inc (reads "V W 2V W V") (10)
Rnd 3: 2 sc, 3 inc, 4 sc, 3 inc, 2 sc (17)
Rnd 4: 3 sc, inc, 2 sc, inc, 6 sc, inc, 2 sc, inc, 3 sc (21)
Rnds 5-8: 24 sc each round (24) [stitch count settles at 24]
Rnd 9: 3 sc, dec, 2 sc, dec, 6 sc, dec, 2 sc, dec, 3 sc (20)
Sew the ears on between Rnds 5-9.
Rnd 10: Change to light brown, 20 sc in BLO (20)
Rnd 11: 3 sc, inc, 2 sc, inc, 7 sc, inc, 2 sc, inc, 2 sc (24)
Rnd 12: 24 sc (24)
Rnd 13: 6 sc, inc, 11 sc, inc, 5 sc (26)
Rnd 14: 26 sc (26)
Rnd 15: 7 sc, inc, 13 sc, inc, 4 sc (28)
Rnd 16: 28 sc (28)
Rnd 17: sc, inc, 13 sc, inc, 12 sc (30)
Rnd 18: 30 sc (30)
Rnd 19: BLO, *3 sc, dec* 6 times (24)
Rnd 20: *2 sc, dec* 6 times (18)
Rnd 21: *sc, dec* 6 times (12)
Leave a tail and use a yarn needle to cinch the opening closed.

Collar (beige, hook 3.5 mm)
Work into the front loops of head/body Rnd 9.
Rnd 1: *4[sc, hdc, sc, hdc, (sc, hdc)]* (a repeat of sc/hdc groups around)
Rnd 2: *12(hdc, sc)*
Rnd 3: 2[(hdc, sc) hdc, sc, hdc, sc] sc, hdc-inc, sc, hdc, sc, hdc, sc (hdc, sc) hdc, sc, hdc, sc, hdc
patterns.chineseText: 古古宝宝！原创作者ig:onpoki。胳膊：R1绿色环形起针6X。R2:5X V。R3-R4:换浅棕色7X。无需填充，将R4压扁后合并钩3X，留长线缝合，胳膊钩2个。耳朵：左耳绿色8CH到三回钩T 4X(2X SL) SL 5T 留长线缝合；右耳绿色8CH到三回钩5T SL(SL 2X)4X T 留长线缝合。头身一体钩织：R1绿色环形起针6X。R2:V W 2V W V。R3:2X 3V 4X 3V 2X。R4:3X V 2X V 6X V 2X V 3X。R5-R8:24X。R9:3X A 2X A 6X A 2X A 3X。耳朵缝合在R5-R9之间。R10:换浅棕色 内半针20X。R11:3X V 2X V 7X V 2X V 2X。R12:24X。R13:6X V 11X V 5X。R14:26X。R15:7X V 13X V 4X。R16:28X。R17:X V 13X V 12X。R18:30X。R19:内半针6(3X A)。R20:6(2X A)。R21:6(X A)。留线直接用缝合针收口。衣领：3.5钩针+米色线，从头身R9外半针开始钩。R1:4[X F X F (XF)]。R2:12(F X)。R3:2[(FX) F X F X] X FV X F X F X (FX) F X F X F。眼睛建议用塑料珠珠。
patterns.notes: Amigurumi Grogu (Baby Yoda). Body green; ears and lower face light brown; collar beige worked on 3.5 mm hook (rest of doll on a smaller hook). Head and body crocheted as one piece, max 30 sts at the widest, closed at Rnd 21. Ears worked flat from a ch-8 base with tr clusters. Eyes: plastic safety beads recommended. Original design by ig: onpoki. (Source shorthand: X=sc, V=inc, A=dec, T=tr, F=hdc, W in Rnd 2 read as a single sc between increases.)

meta.intro: This amigurumi Grogu (Baby Yoda) is crocheted with the head and body as one piece in green, with light-brown ear tips and lower face and a beige collar. It's an adorable, beginner-friendly character doll based on a design by ig: onpoki.
materials: Light brown yarn (ear tips and lower face)
3.5 mm hook (collar; rest of doll on a smaller hook)

faq.question: What eyes should I use?
faq.answer: The pattern recommends plastic safety beads for the eyes. Attach them securely while the head opening is still accessible, before you cinch it closed at Round 21.

faq.question: When do I attach the ears?
faq.answer: Sew the ears on between Rounds 5 and 9 of the head/body. The ears are worked flat from a ch-8 base with tr clusters, and each is left with a long tail for sewing.

faq.question: Are the arms stuffed?
faq.answer: No. The arms are left unstuffed: flatten Round 4 and work 3 sc across through both layers to close, then leave a long tail to sew them onto the body.

faq.question: What do the chart shorthand letters mean?
faq.answer: The source uses X=sc, V=inc (increase), A=dec (decrease), T=tr (treble), and F=hdc. In Round 2 the 'W' is read as a single sc worked between the increases.

title: Walking Mushroom
description:
"行走菇的屁股和表面3cm的部位要去掉，不过脚很好吃，有独特的香味"（脚的气味…吗）
🧶毛线：萌小吖@雪妃尔毛线
🎨颜色：肤白 大红
🪡钩针：1.6mm

#迷宫饭行走菇# #走路菇# #钩针小物# #钩针玩偶# #钩针图解#
author: 芷兰兮

patterns.englishText:
Walking Mushroom — Amigurumi (Dungeon Meshi)

Body (start in MR):
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *sc, inc*, repeat around (18)
Rnd 4: *sc, inc, sc*, repeat around (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc*, repeat around (30)
Rnd 6: *2 sc, inc, 2 sc*, repeat around (36)
Rnd 7: sc, 4 inc, 4 sc, 18 sc, 4 sc, 4 inc, sc (44)
Rnd 8: sc, *sc, dec, sc* x4, 20 sc, *sc, dec, sc* x4, sc (52)
Rnd 9: 52 sc around (52)
Rnd 10: *sc, dec, sc* x4, 44 sc, *dec, sc* x4 (44)
Rnd 11: 6 dec, *3 sc, dec* x4, 6 dec (28)
Rnd 12: *dec, sc* x3, 4 sc, dec, 4 sc, *sc, dec* x3 (21)
Rnd 13: 21 sc around (21)
Rnd 14: 6 sc, *sc, inc, sc* x3, 6 sc (24)
Rnd 15: 24 sc around (24)
Rnd 16: front loops only, *2 hdc-inc, hdc* x8 (40)
Rnd 17: *hdc, hdc-inc, hdc, hdc-inc, hdc* x8 (56) — change color invisibly at Rnd 17

Feet (make 2, start in MR):
Rnd 1: 4 sc in MR (4)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (8)
Rnd 3: 8 sc around (8)

Cap (start in MR):
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *sc, inc*, repeat around (18)
Rnd 4: *sc, inc, sc*, repeat around (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc*, repeat around (30)
Rnd 6: 30 sc around (30)
Rnd 8: *7 sc, inc, 7 sc* x2 (32)
Rnd 9: *3 sc, inc* x8 (40)
Rnd 10: *2 sc, inc, sc* x8 (48)
Rnd 11: *5 sc, inc* x8 (56)
Rnd 12: (insert wire) 56 sc (56) — leave a long tail to sew the cap to body Rnd 17
patterns.notes: Yarn: skin white and bright red. Hook: 1.6 mm. Legs are yarn wrapped over a shaping wire; white dots on the cap are crocheted separately and sewn on; lightly stuff the center of the cap. Designer credit: 芷兰兮. Note: Rnd 8 of cap jumps from Rnd 6 in the source (no Rnd 7 listed).

meta.intro: This walking mushroom amigurumi is inspired by the wandering mushrooms of Dungeon Meshi, with a domed spotted cap, a sturdy body, and little wire-shaped legs that let it stand and pose. The textured cap and bendable feet make it a charming, characterful piece for fans.
materials: yarn in skin white and bright red

faq.question: How do the legs stay posable?
faq.answer: The legs are made by wrapping yarn over a shaping wire, so the finished mushroom can stand and have its feet bent into a walking pose.

faq.question: How are the white dots added to the cap?
faq.answer: The white dots are crocheted separately and sewn onto the cap, rather than worked into the colorwork, which lets you place them wherever you like.

faq.question: How is the cap attached to the body?
faq.answer: Leave a long tail when finishing the cap and use it to sew the cap onto Round 17 of the body; lightly stuff the center of the cap before attaching.

faq.question: Is the round numbering in the cap correct?
faq.answer: Note that the cap instructions jump from Round 6 to Round 8 in the source with no Round 7 listed, so follow the stitch counts in order rather than relying strictly on the round numbers.

title: Stardew Valley Chick
description:
终于完成了！原计划用马赛克钩织的方法，发现豆豆针更可爱。藏线头藏的快碎掉了。钩针号:2.3 线:萌4。图解是用Excel一颗一颗点的，供大家参考~
#像素风# #钩针图解# #欢迎来到像素世界# #钩针祖母格# #星露谷物语# #豆豆针#
author: 苏三是一只猫

patterns.englishText: Stardew Valley Chick — Pixel Colorwork Chart
patterns.chineseText: 像素风钩织~星露谷物语小鸡。Excel 像素色块图(24x24 网格),仅为配色参考:天蓝背景、白云、绿色草地,中间为黄褐色小鸡轮廓配红色鸡冠。无针法符号与针数,系逐格配色图(豆豆针/马赛克钩织用)。
patterns.notes: This is a 24x24 pixel colorwork color-map (built cell-by-cell in Excel) for bean-stitch / mosaic crochet, not a stitch diagram. It only encodes per-cell colors (sky blue background, white clouds, green grass, tan/brown chick with red comb), with no stitch symbols or stitch counts to translate. Hook: 2.3 mm. Read it row by row, one stitch per colored cell.

meta.intro: This Stardew Valley chick is a 24x24 pixel colorwork design that builds a cozy farm scene with sky, clouds, grass, and a little tan chick with a red comb. Worked one stitch per colored cell, it's ideal for a pixel-style panel, coaster, or insert for fans of the game.

faq.question: Is this a stitch diagram or a color chart?
faq.answer: It's a 24x24 pixel colorwork color-map, not a stitch diagram. It only encodes the color of each cell, so there are no stitch symbols or stitch counts to follow.

faq.question: How do I read the chart?
faq.answer: Read it row by row, working one stitch for each colored cell. Each cell tells you which color to use, building the picture pixel by pixel.

faq.question: What technique is the chart intended for?
faq.answer: It's designed for bean-stitch or mosaic-style pixel crochet, where each colored cell corresponds to a single stitch in the finished piece.

faq.question: What colors do I need?
faq.answer: The chart uses sky blue for the background, white for clouds, green for grass, tan/brown for the chick, and red for its comb.

title: Red Toadstool
description:
最近钩的一些蘑菇，今天把图解整理了出来，写得比较仓促，如果有误请给我留言。
线：设得兰 针：2mm
🍄红色大蘑菇图解出自@小物志 的蘑菇一号。🍄黄色蘑菇钩完后，可以用针线将蘑菇盖中心往下勒形成凹陷。🍄浅绿蘑菇图解和绿色蘑菇差不多，针数少一点。
#原创# #图解分享# #一起来钩织# #钩针小物# #蘑菇爱好者#
author: 桃涩桃涩

patterns.englishText:
Red Toadstool — Stalk & Cap

Stalk:
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR (8)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (16)
Rnd 3: *sc, inc*, repeat around (24)
Rnd 4-6: sc in each st around (24)

meta.intro: This collection of textured toadstools includes red, orange, and yellow mushrooms in large and small sizes, each with a stalk, a spotted cap, and a frilled gill skirt worked in front- and back-post stitches. Made in Shetland wool, they make a charming woodland set for shelves or seasonal decor.

faq.question: What yarn and hook are recommended?
faq.answer: The toadstools are worked in Shetland wool with a 2 mm hook, which gives crisp stitch definition for the textured gill rounds.

faq.question: How are the gills under the cap created?
faq.answer: The frilled gill skirt is built with front-post and back-post half double crochets (and post increases) along the stalk, which create the raised, ruffled texture beneath the cap.

faq.question: Should I add the white spots before or after assembly?
faq.answer: Embroider the white spots onto the cap with white yarn first, then join the cap and stalk together with single crochet so the spots are placed cleanly before finishing.

faq.question: Why does the pattern say not to fasten off after the cap?
faq.answer: You leave the yarn attached (do not fasten off or cut) after the cap so you can continue directly into joining the cap to the stalk with single crochet.

meta.intro: A set of cheerful 3D crochet apples, including a flat apple coaster, a dimpled apple-core version, and a small two-tone apple. They make sweet little kitchen accents or stuffed decorations.

faq.question: What hook size should I use for the apple coaster?
faq.answer: The coaster version is worked with a 4.0 mm hook in a double strand of yarn. The other two versions (apple-core and small apple) don't specify a hook, so match your hook to your yarn so the stuffed shapes stay firm with no gaps.

faq.question: When do I change colors on the coaster body?
faq.answer: Work Rnds 1-5 in cream/skin color, then switch to red at Rnd 6 and continue through Rnd 14. Rnd 6 is worked in back loops only (BLO) to create a clean ridge at the color change.

faq.question: When do I stuff and attach the apple core?
faq.answer: On the coaster, sew the brown apple core on after completing Rnd 10. On the apple-core version, add fiberfill at Rnd 16 before closing, then pull the top and bottom centers together for the dimpled apple shape.

faq.question: What do the chart symbols mean?
faq.answer: These patterns use symbol notation: X/x = sc, F = hdc, T = dc, V = inc, A = dec, and W = a small cluster/picot worked for the leaf vein. 外半针 means front loop only (FLO) and 内半针 means back loop only (BLO).

patterns.englishText:
Nintendo Yoshi Brooch — Symbol Chart (Head & Body)

This is a freeform symbol chart for the Yoshi fridge-magnet brooch, worked in colorwork rather than plain rounds. Symbols: chain = ch, F = hdc, T = tr (treble), V = inc, x = sc.

Head (top section):
- White crown: a row of chains across the top with small yellow bobble/dot accents.
- Crest: clusters of white hdc (F) standing up, flanked by red treble (T) spikes on the left.
- Head shaping: rows of green treble (T) worked in a curve, with green inc (V) at the rounded sides and a green chain (ch) base row.

Body / shell (bottom section):
- Green mesh of sc (x) and ch worked in diagonal rows forming the rounded body.
- Red hdc (F) worked as a fan/radiating cluster at the lower left (shell pattern).
- Lower edge trimmed with green hdc/treble (F/T) and inc (V) shaping; brown accent group (sc, V, hdc, F, T) marks a detail at the lower right.

Work the head and body as separate symbol motifs in their respective colors, then assemble into the brooch.
patterns.chineseText: 耀西图解（符号图）。上半部分为耀西头部：顶部白色锁针环 + 黄色圆点装饰，红色 T（长长针）与白色 F（中长针）组成的冠，绿色 T 长针圈与 V 加针构成头身。下半部分为身体/底座：绿色 x（短针）与 ch（锁针）网格，红色 F 放射状针，棕色 oVfFT、x 等组合。图解原创 Lady_Hippo。
patterns.notes: Colorwork symbol chart. Hook 2.0mm. Yarn: 4-ply combed cotton in white, green, red, brown (colors 06, 23, 24, 25). Black oval safety eyes 5 x 6.5mm. Chart is freeform colorwork (not strict numbered rounds); follow symbol shapes per color section.

meta.intro: A crochet Yoshi brooch and fridge magnet inspired by the Nintendo character, worked in colorwork from a freeform symbol chart. The finished piece is a flat, badge-style motif assembled from a head and body section.
materials: 4-ply combed cotton in white, green, red, and brown (colors 06, 23, 24, 25)
Black oval safety eyes, 5 x 6.5 mm

faq.question: What yarn and hook does this brooch use?
faq.answer: It uses 4-ply combed cotton in white, green, red, and brown (color numbers 06, 23, 24, 25) with a 2.0 mm hook, which keeps the colorwork detail crisp at brooch scale.

faq.question: How do I read this chart since it isn't numbered rounds?
faq.answer: It's a freeform colorwork symbol chart, not strict numbered rounds. Follow the symbol shapes within each color section: chain = ch, F = hdc, T = tr (treble), V = inc, and x = sc.

faq.question: Where do I insert my hook for each new row?
faq.answer: Insert your hook under both top loops of the previous stitch (the two horizontal strands forming the V at the top), as shown by the 'hook here' arrow in the technique illustration.

faq.question: How is the brooch put together?
faq.answer: Work the head and body as separate symbol motifs in their respective colors, then assemble them into the brooch and add the black oval safety eyes (5 x 6.5 mm).

title: Summer Vest
description:
在炎炎夏日穿一件绿色背心太凉快啦～ 这个背心不显胖！特别遮肩膀肉肉！钩织简单，新手也可以轻松上手。
线材：@苏苏姐家 5号蕾丝（4团）钩针：2.0mm 钩织时长：3天
网格起针78个，参考图五圈钩，腋下减针两边一样。
#钩针背心 #夏日背心 #钩针图解
author: 是小橙呀

patterns.englishText:
Summer Vest — Main Body Stitch Pattern

Worked flat in rows (chart read bottom to top; arrows show working direction, blue triangle = turning chain at row start, red oval = slip-stitch join).

Foundation: Ch a multiple to desired width (the sample uses 78 ch for the mesh foundation).
Row 1: Working into the foundation chain, sc/dc base row across to set the stitches.
Row 2: Ch for turning, then dc in each stitch across, working in groups with ch-1 spaces between paired dc to form the open mesh.
Rows 3-5 (and repeat upward): Ch to turn, *dc, ch 1* across, placing the dc into the stitches/spaces of the previous row to continue the vertical-bar mesh pattern. Repeat this row for the full body length.

The pattern is a simple repeating dc-and-chain mesh; continue the row repeat until the body reaches the required length.
patterns.chineseText: 主体花样（符号图）。底部为锁针起针网格行，往上为长针(T形符号)成排排列、每排之间有锁针，红点标记引拔接合处，蓝三角为起立针。右侧标注行数 1-5（数字是钩织行数）。图例：标记入针点 / 引拔 / 起立 / 钩织方向。
patterns.notes: Main body chart for the summer vest, worked flat in rows. Yarn: #5 lace-weight cotton (4 skeins). Hook 2.0mm. Foundation 78 ch. Work 5 rounds per reference, then shape underarm decreases equally on both sides. Chart legend: stitch-placement marker, slip-stitch join, turning chain, working direction.

patterns.englishText:
Summer Vest — Underarm Shaping & Armhole Edging

Worked flat in rows, continuing the dc mesh from the main body chart (rows numbered at right).

Rows 34-36 (Body): Continue the *dc, ch 1* mesh across the full width.
Underarm decrease (rows ~36+): At each underarm, slip-stitch / skip stitches to drop the armhole stitches, then decrease at both armhole edges equally so the two sides match. This splits the work to leave the armhole openings.
Armhole edging (rows up to 66): Work the two front/back panels up each side of the armhole opening, continuing the dc mesh straight up (no further increases) to the shoulder at row 66.

Work both armhole sides identically.
patterns.chineseText: 符号图：背心腋下减针与袖口钩织。底部 34、35、36 行为身体片，中间标注「腋下减针」，两侧向上为「袖口钩织」长针排列，顶部标注第 66 行。长针(T形符号)成排，每排锁针连接。
patterns.notes: Armhole/shoulder shaping chart for the summer vest. "袖口钩织" = armhole edging worked up each side; "腋下减针" = underarm decrease, done equally on both sides. Rows run from 34 (body) up to 66 (shoulder). Hook 2.0mm, #5 lace-weight cotton.

meta.intro: A lightweight summer vest worked flat in a simple open dc-and-chain mesh from a lace-weight cotton. Its airy vertical-bar pattern makes it a breezy warm-weather layer.

faq.question: How much yarn and what hook do I need?
faq.answer: The sample uses 4 skeins of #5 lace-weight cotton with a 2.0 mm hook, which gives the fine, open mesh its drape.

faq.question: How many chains do I start with?
faq.answer: The sample foundation is 78 chains for the mesh, but since this is a simple repeating *dc, ch 1* pattern you can chain a multiple to your desired width.

faq.question: How is the vest shaped and constructed?
faq.answer: It's worked flat in rows. Continue the dc mesh for the body, then at the underarms decrease equally on both sides to drop the armhole stitches, and work each side straight up to the shoulder (about row 66 in the chart). Work both armhole sides identically.

faq.question: How do I read the chart?
faq.answer: Read it bottom to top; arrows show the working direction, a blue triangle marks the turning chain at the start of a row, and a red oval marks a slip-stitch join.

感谢老师的大胖鸡参考，我改了主题尾部位置，增加了鸡冠和小鸡嘴的图解

**标签**: 图解, 冰条线, 小胖鸡, 钩针, 钩织, 钩针图解, 毛线手工, diy, 钩针小物, 阿瑶的钩织小屋
author: 今天阿瑶钩什么

patterns.englishText:
Chubby Chick — Amigurumi

Body (cream):
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR (8)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (16)
Rnd 3: *sc, inc*, repeat around (24)
Rnd 4: *sc, inc, sc*, repeat around (32)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc*, repeat around (40)
Rnd 6: *2 sc, inc, 2 sc*, repeat around (48)
Rnd 7: BLO, sc in each st around (48)
Rnd 8-12: sc in each st around (48)
Rnd 13: 2 inc, 44 sc, 2 inc (52)
Rnd 14: 2 sc, *4 sc, dec* x8, 2 sc (44)
Rnd 15: 2 dec, 36 sc, 2 dec (40)
Rnd 16: dec, *2 sc, dec* x9, dec (29)
Fold flat and seam closed; leave the last stitch open.

Comb (wine red): (ch 2, hdc inc, ch 2), sl st, (ch, dc, ch), sl st

Beak (ginger yellow): ch 3, pull tight and sew on

Eyes: black, sewn on
patterns.chineseText: 小胖鸡图解。身体:乳白色 R1:环起8x R2:8v R3:(x,v)*8 R4:(x,v,x)*8 R5:(3x,v)*8 R6:(2x,v,2x)*8 R7:BLO(内半针)48x R8-R12:48x R13:2v,44x,2v[52] R14:2x,(4x,A)*8,2x[44] R15:2A,36x,2A[40] R16:A,(2x,A)*9,A[29] 对折缝合,最后一针空着不用管。鸡冠:酒红色 (2ch,fv,2ch),sl,(ch,t,ch),sl。嘴:姜黄色 3ch拉紧缝合。眼睛:黑色缝合。
patterns.notes: Yarn: 7 mm chenille (colors per chart). Hook: 7 mm. Stuffing: approx 150 g. Comb in wine red, beak in ginger yellow, eyes in black.

meta.intro: This chubby little chick is a quick chenille amigurumi with a rounded body, a tiny red comb, and a stubby beak. Its plump shape and squishy yarn make it a fast, satisfying make and a cute desk or shelf companion.
materials: 7 mm chenille yarn (cream body, wine red comb, ginger yellow beak)

faq.question: What yarn and hook does this chick use?
faq.answer: It's worked in 7 mm chenille (velvet) yarn with a 7 mm hook, which gives the body its soft, plush look. Cream is used for the body, wine red for the comb, and ginger yellow for the beak.

faq.question: How is the body finished off at the end?
faq.answer: After the final decrease round, fold the opening flat and seam it closed, leaving the very last stitch open so you can shape and close the body neatly.

faq.question: Why does Round 7 work in back loops only (BLO)?
faq.answer: Working Round 7 in BLO creates a defined ridge that sets the base of the body and helps the chick sit flat, separating the bottom from the sides.

faq.question: How much stuffing should I use?
faq.answer: The pattern calls for about 150 g of stuffing. Because chenille is bulky and stretchy, stuff firmly so the round body holds its shape without the stitches gaping.

title: Bikini Bottom Character
description:
#钩针图解 #图解 #比奇堡

**标签**: 钩针图解, 图解, 比奇堡
author: 你

patterns.englishText:
Bikini Bottom Character — Amigurumi Doll

Fins (Tunisian / afghan technique):
Row 1: ch 13, working from 2nd ch from hook, work 12 incomplete sc, draw through 2 at a time — repeat the draw-off 12 times.
Row 2: ch 1, 11 incomplete sc, draw off 2 at a time x6, continue forward into 6 more incomplete sc, draw off 2 at a time x11.
Row 3: ch 1, 11 incomplete sc, draw off 2 at a time x11.
Row 4: ch 1, 10 incomplete sc, draw off 2 at a time x10.
Row 5: ch 1, 8 incomplete sc, draw off 2 at a time x8. Sew at center back, between blue rounds 2 and beyond.
Row 6: ch 1, 7 incomplete sc, draw off 2 at a time x7. Sew at center back, between blue rounds 2 and beyond.

Eye Whites (3-ply yarn, 1.8 mm hook, 3 mm eyes):
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3-4: 12 sc around (12)
Work with wrong side out.

Eyelids (2-ply yarn, 1.8 mm hook, work loosely):
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR (8)
Rnd 2: *sc, inc* x4 (12)
Rnd 3-5: 12 sc around (12)
Insert eye whites into the eyelids.

Mouth: ch 11, from 2nd ch from hook, (sl st, sc, tr, tr-inc, tr, tr-inc, tr, sc, sl st), ch 2; repeat the bracketed sequence along the opposite side, ch 2, sl st. Fold with wrong side inside; sew at center, mouth corners at blue Rnd 3, mid-section at Rnd 4.

Eyebrows: ch 5, from 2nd ch from hook, sc, 3 sl st

Spots (1-ply yarn, hook under 1.0 mm):
Large: ch 5, from 2nd ch from hook, 4 sc, (ch, 4 sc, ch 1), sl st
Small: ch 4, join first and last
patterns.chineseText: 比奇堡系列(海超人/泡泡精灵风格人偶)。鳍(阿富汗针法):1.13ch倒2,12个未完成x,两两退出,退12次。2.1ch,11个未完成义(x),两两退出6次,继续往前钩6个未完成x,两两退出,11次。3.1ch,11个未完成x,两两退出,11次。4.1ch,10个未完成x,两两退出,10次。5.1ch,8个未完成x,两两退出,8次。缝在后中,蓝色第2-个圈之间。6.1ch,7个未完成x,两两退出,7次。缝在后中,蓝色第2-个圈之间。眼白(3股线1.8针0.3m眼睛):R1:环起6x R2:6v R3-4:12x 反面在外。眼皮(2股线1.8针钩松点):R1:环起8x R2:4(x,v) R3-5:12x 把眼白装到眼皮里。嘴:11ch,倒2,(sl,x,T,TV,T,TV,T x,sl,)2ch,对面重复括号里面的针法2ch,sl,对折反面在里,缝在正中嘴角在蓝色第3圈,中间部分在第4圈。眉毛:5ch,倒2,x,3sl。斑点(1股线1.0以下钩针):大.5ch倒2.4x,(ch,4x,1ch,s2 小.4ch.首尾相连。
patterns.notes: Made in blue, white, and pink. Eye whites use 3-ply yarn with 1.8 mm hook and 3 mm safety eyes; eyelids use 2-ply yarn. Spots worked with very fine (<1.0 mm) hook and single-ply yarn. Fins use Tunisian/afghan crochet.

meta.intro: This amigurumi doll recreates a beloved Bikini Bottom character, built from separately worked features like detailed eyes, mouth, fins, and spots that are sewn onto the body. The expressive face pieces and Tunisian-crochet fins give it a lot of personality despite its small parts.

faq.question: What crochet techniques do I need to know for this doll?
faq.answer: Besides standard amigurumi rounds, the fins are worked in Tunisian (afghan) crochet using incomplete single crochets that you draw off two at a time, so some familiarity with Tunisian technique helps.

faq.question: Why are the eyes made from two separate pieces?
faq.answer: The eyes use a white inner piece (eye whites) worked wrong-side-out with a 3 mm safety eye, then inserted into a separate eyelid piece worked loosely in 2-ply yarn, which layers them for an expressive look.

faq.question: What yarn weights and hooks are used across the parts?
faq.answer: It's a fine-yarn project: eye whites use 3-ply yarn with a 1.8 mm hook, eyelids use 2-ply yarn, and the tiny spots use single-ply yarn with a hook under 1.0 mm.

faq.question: How are the facial features positioned on the body?
faq.answer: Use the blue rounds as landmarks: the mouth corners sit at blue Round 3 with the mid-section at Round 4, and the fins are sewn at center back from blue Round 2 upward.

title: Little Cockroach
description:

patterns.englishText:
Little Cockroach — Amigurumi

Head:
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR (8)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (16)
Rnd 3: *sc, inc*, repeat around (24)
Rnd 4: *sc, inc, sc*, repeat around (32)
Rnd 5-8: 32 sc around (32)
Rnd 9: 9 sc, 4 inc, 6 sc, 4 inc, 9 sc (40)
Rnd 10-11: 40 sc around (40)
Rnd 12: 9 sc, 4 dec, 6 sc, 4 dec, 9 sc (32)
Rnd 13: *sc, dec, sc*, repeat around (24)
Rnd 14: *sc, dec*, repeat around (16)

Body:
Rnd 15: change color, work in front loops only: 16 sc (16)
Rnd 16: *sc, inc*, repeat around (24)
Rnd 17: *sc, inc, sc*, repeat around (32)
Rnd 18-20: 32 sc around (32)
Rnd 21: *sc, dec, sc*, repeat around (24)
Rnd 22: 24 sc around (24)
Rnd 23: *sc, dec*, repeat around (16)
Rnd 24-25: 16 sc around (16)
Rnd 26: 8 dec (8)

Wings (make 2):
Row 1: ch 9, from 2nd ch from hook: 2 dc, 4 hdc, dc, (3 sc), dc, 4 hdc, 2 dc
Row 2: 7 sc, 3 inc, 7 sc
Row 3: 7 sc, 6 inc, 7 sc

Legs (make 2): ch 3, from 3rd ch from hook sl st, ch 2
patterns.notes: Body color changes at Rnd 15 (worked in front loops only). Wings and legs made in pairs.

meta.intro: This cheeky little cockroach amigurumi has a rounded head, a tapered body, and a pair of small wings and legs for a playful, slightly goofy look. It's a fun novelty make that comes together quickly from a few simple pieces.

faq.question: How are the head and body connected?
faq.answer: After finishing the head, you change color and work Round 15 into the front loops only, which creates a clean ridge where the body begins and gives the join a defined edge.

faq.question: How many wings and legs do I need to make?
faq.answer: Make two wings and two legs. The wings are worked as short rows starting from a foundation chain, and the legs are tiny chains with a slip stitch.

faq.question: What stitches are used in the wings?
faq.answer: The wings use a mix of double crochet, half double crochet, and single crochet across the first row to shape a curved wing, then single crochet and increases to widen them.

faq.question: Does the pattern specify yarn or hook size?
faq.answer: No yarn brand or hook size is stated in the pattern, so choose a yarn and a hook one size smaller than the ball band recommends to keep the amigurumi fabric tight and the stuffing hidden.

title: Horse Pendant
description:
小马挂件，附图解

**标签**: #马年小马已就位 #一起来钩织 #钩针挂件 #钩针小物 #小马 #我的小马驹 #钩针图解 #钩织的乐趣
author: 玩儿个毛线吖（接🥚）

patterns.englishText:
Horse Pendant — Complete Pattern

Body (make 2 pieces):
Row 1: Ch 5, starting in 2nd ch from hook, 4 sc in back bumps (4)
Row 2: Turn, sc, inc, 2 sc (5)
Rows 3-4: Turn, 5 sc. Fasten off. (5)

Make a second piece (Rows 1-4) but do NOT fasten off, continue:
Row 5: Turn, 4 sc, inc, ch 6, join to first piece, inc, 4 sc (18 including chain)
Rows 6-11: Turn, 18 sc (18)
Row 12: Turn, 16 sc, dec (17)
Row 13: Turn, dec, 14 sc, inc (17)
Row 14: Turn, dec, 14 sc, inc (17)
Row 15: Turn, dec, 6 sc, inc, ch 5 (for head)
Row 16: Starting in 2nd ch from hook, 5 sc, inc, 5 sc, dec
Row 17: Turn, dec, 5 sc, inc, 5 sc
Row 18: Turn, 5 sc, inc, 5 sc, dec
Row 19: Turn, dec, 5 sc, inc, 5 sc

Head shaping:
Row 20: Turn, 6 sc, inc, 4 sc, dec
Row 21: Turn, dec, 4 sc, dec
Row 22: Turn, dec, 2 sc, dec
Row 23: Turn, dec twice. Fasten off.

Join two pieces: Sc around the edge, inc at corners. Border with contrasting color sl st around.

Saddle:
Row 1: Ch 10, starting in 2nd ch from hook: 8 sc, 3 sc in last st (corner), 7 sc on other side, inc (20)
Row 2: Inc, 7 hdc, 3 inc, 7 hdc, 2 inc (26)
Row 3: Sc around without inc/dec. Sl st border in accent color. Attach mane and tail.

Coin:
Rnd 1: Ch 21, starting in 2nd ch from hook: *(hdc, dc, tr, sl st)*, repeat 4 times, join in round
Rnd 2: *(4 sc, inc)*, repeat 4 times (make 2 pieces). Sew together with gold thread.

小马钩织图解

patterns.notes: X=sc, V=inc, A=dec, W=3sc in 1st, T=hdc, F=dc, E=tr. Flat piece worked in turned rows, then two pieces joined. Add mane and tail with yarn fringe.

meta.intro: A flat crocheted horse charm complete with a saddle and a dangling coin, this little pendant makes a charming bag accessory, keychain, or zipper pull. Worked in turned rows and joined into a two-sided motif, it is a quick decorative project with playful detail.
materials: Yarn (a main color plus a contrasting/accent color for the border)
Gold thread for joining the coin
Yarn needle for sewing and assembly

faq.question: How is the horse assembled?
faq.answer: Make two matching body pieces (Rows 1-4), then continue the second piece through the body and head shaping. Hold the two pieces together and sc around the edge with increases at the corners, then add a contrasting sl st border around the outside.

faq.question: How do I add the mane and tail?
faq.answer: They are added as yarn fringe. Cut short lengths of yarn and attach them along the neck for the mane and at the back for the tail, then trim to length.

faq.question: What does the saddle attach to?
faq.answer: The saddle is worked separately as a small flat piece (Rows 1-3) finished with an accent-color sl st border, then sewn onto the joined horse body.

faq.question: Why does the pattern use letters like X, V, A and W?
faq.answer: These are Chinese-notation symbols mapped in the text: X=sc, V=inc, A=dec, W=3 sc in one stitch, T=hdc, F=dc, E=tr. Translate them to the US terms as you read the chart.

author: 阿瑶睡不醒吖

patterns.englishText:
Cherry Blossom & Lily of the Valley Pendant — Step 1: Cherry Blossom Petals

patterns.notes: Use 2.0mm hook. Color numbers: 40, 04, 12. Photo tutorial showing step-by-step construction.

patterns.englishText:
Cherry Blossom & Lily of the Valley Pendant — Step 2: Lily of the Valley Buds

Rnd 1: 5 sc in MR (5)
Rnd 2: Ch 3, 5 (dc, ch 1) around (5 ch-sps)

patterns.englishText:
Cherry Blossom & Lily of the Valley Pendant — Complete Written Pattern

Cherry Blossom Piece (make 2):
Rnd 1: MR, ch 4, *(dc, ch 1)*, repeat 9 times, sl st to join (9 dc, 9 ch-sps)
Rnd 2: Change color. *[In first ch-sp: sc, ch 1. In next ch-sp: (dc, ch 1) x 3]*, repeat 5 times (5 petals)
Rnd 3: *[In first dc of petal: sc, hdc, ch 1. In second dc: dc, ch 3, sl st in 3rd ch from hook (picot), ch 3, dc, ch 1. In third dc: hdc, sc]*, repeat 5 times (5 petals with picots)
Make 2 pieces. Sew together through back loops.

Lily of the Valley Bud (make 4):
Rnd 1: 5 sc in MR (5)
Rnd 2: Ch 3, *(dc, ch 1)*, repeat 5 times (5 ch-sps)
Rnd 3: Change color. In each of the 6 spaces: 6 incomplete hdc, yarn over and pull through all loops, ch 1 (6 puff stitches)
Rnd 4: Between each puff: *(sc, 2 dc, sc)*, repeat 6 times around
patterns.chineseText:
樱花铃兰花

樱花片：
R1:环起，4CH,(F、CH)*9
R2：换线，[在第1圈洞内钩X、CH，下个洞内(F、CH)*3]*5
R3（在第2圈的第一个F处钩X、T、CH，第二个F处钩F、3CH、SL、3CH、F、CH，第三个F处钩T、X)*5
花片需钩织两片，挑内半针缝合。

铃兰花：
R1:5x
R2:3CH，5（F，CH）
R3:换线，在6个大洞里分别钩6个未完成中长针，一次性拖过所有线圈，锁一针
R4:在两个花瓣中间钩（X，2F，X），重复6次
patterns.notes: Use 2.0mm hook. F=dc, X=sc, T=hdc, CH=ch, SL=sl st. Cherry blossom uses 2 colors (pink center + lighter petals). Lily of the valley uses green + white.

meta.intro: A delicate floral pendant pairing a layered cherry blossom motif with small bell-shaped lily of the valley buds that hang below. Worked in fine thread on a tiny hook, it is a pretty bag charm or necklace accent for anyone who loves dainty botanical crochet.
materials: Fine thread/yarn in pink and a lighter pink for the cherry blossom
Green and white thread for the lily of the valley
Yarn needle for sewing pieces together and attaching straps

faq.question: How many pieces do I need to make?
faq.answer: Make 2 cherry blossom pieces (sewn together through the back loops) and 4 lily of the valley buds that hang from the pendant.

faq.question: How are the picot petals formed?
faq.answer: On the final cherry blossom round, each petal point is shaped with a picot: dc, ch 3, sl st in the 3rd ch from the hook, ch 3, dc. This gives the petals their pointed, scalloped edge.

faq.question: How is the puff-stitch bud made?
faq.answer: Each lily of the valley bud uses a puff: work 6 incomplete hdc into the same space, then yarn over and pull through all loops at once and ch 1 to close. Repeat in each space around for the bell shape.

faq.question: What hook should I use?
faq.answer: The pattern specifies a 2.0mm hook with fine thread; going larger will loosen the lacy petals and make the pendant less crisp.

faq.question: How is the star shape formed?
faq.answer: After working the flat circular base (Rnds 1-4), each of the five points is shaped individually over 8 stitches using decreases (sc2tog) across Rows 5-9, then a sc border is worked around the whole edge.

faq.question: How do I assemble the star fruit?
faq.answer: Make two star pieces, leaving a long tail on one for sewing. Hold them together, stuff lightly as you sew around, then attach the two leaves.

faq.question: What does sc2tog do here?
faq.answer: sc2tog is a single-crochet decrease that works two stitches together as one; it is used at the ends of the point rows to taper each star point to a sharp tip.

meta.intro: A round coaster with a pretty scalloped shell-stitch edge, worked in the round from a magic ring outward. Made in milk cotton, it is a quick home-decor project that protects tabletops with a touch of handmade charm.

faq.question: What yarn works best for this coaster?
faq.answer: The pattern uses 5-ply milk cotton (the barrel type), but notes that 4-ply is sufficient. Cotton holds the round, flat shape well and is absorbent for use under cups.

faq.question: How is the scalloped edge made?
faq.answer: The final round (Rnd 8) creates the scallops with a shell stitch: sc, skip 1, 5 dc in the same stitch, skip 1, repeated around and ending with a sc and sl st to join.

faq.question: How do I join each round neatly?
faq.answer: After the last sc of the final round, sl st into the first sc of that round to close it; the dc rounds begin with a ch 2 to stand in for the first dc.

patterns.notes: Stardew Valley character pixel art. 24x24 grid. Numbers represent stitch counts for color changes.

meta.intro: A 24x24 pixel-art chart of a Stardew Valley character, ready to crochet as a coaster, mug rug, or small wall hanging. It's perfect for fans of the game who want to practice color changes in tapestry or corner-to-corner crochet.

faq.question: How do I read the numbers in each cell?
faq.answer: Each number tells you how many consecutive stitches to work in that color before the next color change. It's a run-length count, not a stitch type, so you simply work that many stitches of the indicated color across the row.

faq.question: Should I use tapestry crochet or C2C for this chart?
faq.answer: Either works. Tapestry crochet (worked flat in single crochet, carrying unused colors inside the stitches) gives a denser, pixel-perfect square, while corner-to-corner (C2C) builds the grid on the diagonal in small blocks. Both follow the same 24x24 grid.

faq.question: How do I keep the piece square at 24x24?
faq.answer: Tapestry crochet in single crochet naturally reads close to square, but check your gauge on a small swatch first. If the fabric comes out tall and narrow, go up a hook size or work in half double crochet to widen each cell.
