meta.intro: A delicate lace scarf worked in fine thread, shaped like an elongated diamond with tapered points at each end. The airy fan-and-mesh "firework" pattern makes it a lightweight, dressy accessory for spring and summer.

faq.question: Why use such a small 2.0mm hook?
faq.answer: The scarf is worked in fine size 5 lace thread, so a 2.0mm hook keeps the stitches tight enough to hold the open fan-and-mesh pattern crisply. A larger hook would loosen the lace and lose the firework effect.

faq.question: How is the diamond shape formed?
faq.answer: You start with a small foundation (ch 4 plus 3 dc), increase on both sides until the scarf reaches your desired width, work straight through the even section for length, then decrease on both sides back down to a single stitch, creating the pointed oval/diamond ends.

faq.question: Can I make the scarf wider or longer?
faq.answer: Yes. Continue the side increases until you reach the width you want, then add more pattern repeats in the even section to lengthen it before you begin decreasing. The shaping is driven by where you stop increasing.

meta.intro: A versatile collection of 21 small crochet flowers plus 5 matching leaves, ranging from simple single-round blooms to layered, multi-petal designs. They're ideal for appliques, bouquets, brooches, and decorating bags, hats, and home projects.

faq.question: Which flower should a beginner start with?
faq.answer: Start with Flowers 1, 2, or 3. They are single-round or two-round designs worked from a magic ring using only chains, double crochet, and slip stitches, so you get a finished bloom in just a few minutes.

faq.question: How do the two-layer flowers work?
faq.answer: Flowers 9, 15, and 21 use front-loop and back-loop construction. You work the first set of petals into the front loops of a round, then go back and work a second, larger set into the remaining back loops behind them, giving a layered, dimensional bloom.

faq.question: Which leaves go with which flowers?
faq.answer: The collection includes 5 leaves matched to different flowers: Leaf 1 for small potted plants, Leaf 2 for chrysanthemums, Leaf 3 for roses, Leaf 4 for daisies and small flowers, and Leaf 5 (with a stem) for green arrangements.

faq.question: What does "3-dc cluster" mean in Flower 14 and 16?
faq.answer: A cluster joins several incomplete double crochets together at the top into one stitch. For a 3-dc cluster, work three double crochets but stop before the final yarn-over on each, then pull through all loops at once to draw them into a single textured point.

meta.intro: A charming black cat face placemat worked in tapestry crochet from a pixel grid chart, shown in a cheerful pink-and-black colorway. It makes a quick, gift-worthy table accent and a great introduction to reading color charts.

faq.question: What crochet technique does this placemat use?

faq.question: How is the textured body created?

faq.question: How does the bag stay closed?

meta.intro: A rose-shaped net holder that wraps a water bottle or cup in four crocheted petals, each formed from a growing loop of chains. It doubles as a pretty, reusable bottle carrier you can clip to a bag.

faq.question: How does the rose petal shape form?
faq.answer: Each petal is built from a chain loop that grows every round (ch 3, then 7, 9, 13, 17, 23, 31), with that chain space filled by single crochet. The increasing loops make each petal larger so they curl into a rose that cradles the bottle.

faq.question: What do the symbols in the pattern mean?
faq.answer: The notes give a quick legend: X = single crochet, ch = chain, K1 = skip 1 stitch, and SL = slip stitch. Keeping these straight is key, since the slip stitches at the start of several rounds reposition you before the next petal.

faq.question: Will it fit any bottle?
faq.answer: The net stretches, so it adapts to many cup and bottle sizes. For a snugger or looser fit, adjust your hook size or yarn thickness rather than changing the chain counts.

faq.question: How is the hair attached to the head?
faq.answer: The hair is built from many individual chained strands of varying lengths. The bangs are worked first, then the back-of-head hair is made by chaining 48, wrapping it around the back of the head, and securing it. Each strand is worked back along its starting chain using sl st, sc, hdc, and dc to create natural taper.

faq.question: Why do the strands use different stitch heights along their length?
faq.answer: Mixing sl st, sc, hdc, and dc within a single strand makes the hair curl and lie in a more lifelike way. Shorter stitches at the base keep the strand flat near the scalp while taller dc toward the tip add curve and volume.

faq.question: Do I need to make both sides of the bangs separately?
faq.answer: No. After working Strands 1, 2, and 3, you repeat Strand 3, 2, 1 in reverse order to mirror the bangs on the other side so the front is symmetrical.

faq.question: What is a Sunny Doll?
faq.answer: A Sunny Doll is the crochet version of a teru teru bozu, a traditional good-weather charm shaped like a round head with a draped body. Coco is a chocolate-themed version finished with a beret, scarf, and bow tie.

faq.question: Why does the final head round use BLO?
faq.answer: Round 13 works the closing decreases in the back loops only (BLO). Working in the back loops creates a clean fold line so the remaining stitches cinch closed neatly without a bulky gap.

faq.question: How are the skirt and beret shaped?
faq.answer: Both the skirt and the beret use double crochet increases (dc inc) spaced progressively further apart each round, which flares the fabric outward. The beret then decreases with sc and dec near the brim to pull it back in to hat shape.

faq.question: How do I read the dolphin symbol chart?
faq.answer: Work from the center of the chart outward, following the symbols for sc, hdc, dc, and tr. The dolphin is two-tone: light blue forms the body and back while dark blue forms the belly and fins, so change colors where the chart indicates.

faq.question: How is the heart brooch started?
faq.answer: The heart begins with a magic ring (MR), then dc and tr stitches radiate outward over about two rounds to form the heart shape. Taller stitches in the right places give the heart its rounded lobes and pointed bottom.

faq.question: How do I turn the motif into a brooch?

[Rnd 10: Join in round]

meta.intro: A knitted bubble-style princess dress sized for a Labubu doll, worked top-down with a yoke before joining in the round and adding short sleeves. Note that this is a knitting pattern rather than crochet, ideal for dressing up a collectible doll.

faq.question: Is this a crochet or knitting pattern?
faq.answer: This is a knitting pattern, not crochet. It uses knit stitches with YO (yarn over) increases and K2tog decreases, worked on knitting needles rather than a crochet hook.

faq.question: How is the dress constructed?
faq.answer: It starts with 36 stitches cast on and is worked flat for the yoke, with raglan-style YO increases shaping the body and sleeve sections. At Row 10 the work is joined in the round, the sleeve stitches are held aside, and the body continues down before the held stitches are picked up to knit the sleeves.

faq.question: How do I make the bubble effect at the hem?
faq.answer: The body is increased dramatically (up to 210 stitches around Round 25) and then sharply decreased with paired K2tog clusters in Round 27, which gathers the fabric into the puffed bubble shape that gives the dress its name.

faq.question: How do I work the popcorn stitch?
faq.answer: Work 5 dc into the same stitch, then remove your hook from the working loop, insert it into the first dc of the group, pull the working loop back through, and ch 1 to secure. This pops the cluster of dc forward to mimic a piece of popcorn.

faq.question: How does the sleeve turn into a net bag?

faq.question: How are the vertical red and white stripes made?

meta.intro: A large, huggable elephant amigurumi inspired by the Mao Buyi character style, built from an oval body with four picked-up legs, a sculpted trunk, and floppy ears. Its size and soft shaping make it a standout plushie or nursery decoration.
materials: Crochet hook suited to the yarn

faq.question: How are the four legs attached to the body?
faq.answer: The legs are not sewn on separately. Each leg starts by picking up stitches directly from the body and from the chain spaces (the leg chains A, B, C, D) marked around the oval, then is worked in the round and decreased closed. This gives a seamless join.

faq.question: What creates the trunk opening?
faq.answer: On Rnd 23 of the body you work 39 sc, chain 6 while skipping 12 sc, then 39 sc. That skipped section plus the chain forms the hole; the trunk is later worked by rejoining yarn and picking up stitches around that opening.

faq.question: Why does the pattern stress tension on the first round?
faq.answer: Rnd 1 should be worked slightly tight so the starting oval stays closed, while the following rounds are kept slightly loose. This keeps the body surface smooth and prevents the oval base from gaping or puckering.

faq.question: How does the belly piece fit?
faq.answer: The belly is a flat 24-stitch oval that sews onto the edges of the four leg chains. It is sized so 24 stitches equal 4 legs times 6 chain stitches each, so it should fit exactly once the body and trunk are stuffed firmly.

faq.question: What order do the color changes go in?
faq.answer: Starting from the pencil tip: natural/cream for the point, then light yellow, then yellow for the long body (Rnds 8-32), gray for the metal ferrule, and pink for the eraser at the top.

faq.question: Why is Rnd 2 of the feet worked in back loops only?
faq.answer: Working that round in BLO (back loops only) creates a defined edge that shapes the little foot and keeps it from curling, helping the two feet sit flat against the body when sewn on.

faq.question: How much should I stuff the body?
faq.answer: Because the body is a long narrow tube only 20 stitches around, stuff it lightly and gradually as you go so it stays straight and pencil-like rather than bulging in the middle.

meta.intro: A micro-crochet gloriosa (flame lily) worked entirely from symbol charts, with distinctive ruffled petals plus leaf and stamen pieces. Its striking shape makes it a standout accent for brooches, bouquets, or fine decorative work.

faq.question: Is there written text for this pattern?
faq.answer: No. The gloriosa lily is provided as a symbol chart only, so you will need to read crochet symbols for the petals, leaves, and stamens rather than follow written rows.

faq.question: Which stitches does the petal chart use?
faq.answer: The petals are formed from chains, single crochet, half double crochet, double crochet, and treble crochet, which together create the tapering, ruffled petal shape.

faq.question: What hook and thread suit this micro-crochet lily?
faq.answer: The pattern calls for fine thread and a small hook. A steel hook matched to the thread weight keeps the tiny stitches crisp and the finished lily delicate.

patterns.englishText:
Jessie Amigurumi Doll — Terms & Materials

ABBREVIATIONS:
ch = chain
sc = single crochet
inc = increase
dec = decrease
hdc = half double crochet
dc = double crochet
W = 3 sc into the same stitch
3tog = crochet 3 stitches together
sl st = slip stitch
(...)*N = repeat the instructions in parentheses N times
FLO = front loop only
BLO = back loop only
patterns.chineseText: TERMS（术语）与 MATERIALS（材料）页。术语：Ch=锁针, Sc=短针, inc=加针, dec=减针, Hdc=中长针, Dc=长针, W=同一针里3短针, 3tog=3并1, slst=引拔针, (...)* =重复*次, Flo=前半针, Blo=后半针。材料见英文。
patterns.notes: Yarn: worsted/sport cotton (e.g. Catania-weight). Colors used: Skin (Head, Arms, Body, Ears); Ecru (Legs, Body, Arms, Hat); Black (Legs); Blue (Body, Legs); Yellow (Body); Brown (Legs, Belt); Red (Hat); Light Orange (Hair). Hook: 2.20 mm. Also needed: 8 mm safety eyes, colored pencil (for cheek blush), fiberfill, stitch marker, tapestry needle, scissors. (Brand names dropped per house style.)

patterns.englishText:
Jessie Amigurumi Doll — Head

Head (stuff firmly as you go)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *sc, inc*, rep around (18)
Rnd 4: *2 sc, inc*, rep around (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc*, rep around (30)
Rnd 6: 2 sc, inc, *4 sc, inc* x5, 2 sc (36)
Rnd 7: *5 sc, inc*, rep around (42)
Rnds 8-15: sc in each st around (42)
Rnd 16: 14 sc, *4 inc, 6 sc* x2, 8 sc (50)
Rnds 17-19: sc in each st around (50)
Insert the safety eyes between Rnds 15 and 16, leaving 4 sc between them; place them on the increase sts of Rnd 16.
Rnd 20: *3 sc, dec* x10 (40)
Rnd 21: *8 sc, dec* x4 (36)
Rnd 22: *4 sc, dec* x6 (30)
Rnd 23: *3 sc, dec* x6 (24)
Rnd 24: *2 sc, dec* x6 (18)
Rnds 25-31: sc in each st around (18)
Fasten off. Push the tube crocheted from Rnd 25 down into the head to form the neck, as shown in the photos.
patterns.notes: Skin color. 8 mm safety eyes set between Rnds 15-16 on the Rnd 16 increases. Add cheek blush with colored pencil. The Rnd 25-31 tube becomes the neck.

patterns.englishText:
Jessie Amigurumi Doll — Hair & Fringe

Hair
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *sc, inc*, rep around (18)
Rnd 4: *2 sc, inc*, rep around (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc*, rep around (30)
Rnd 6: 2 sc, inc, *4 sc, inc* x5, 2 sc (36)
Rnd 7: *5 sc, inc*, rep around (42)
Rnds 8-9: sc in each st around (42)
Rnd 10: *6 sc, inc*, rep around (48)
Rnds 11-14: sc in each st around (48)
Hair strands: *ch 25, starting from the 2nd ch: 24 sc back down the chain, 1 sl st into the 14th row of the cap* x3. Fasten off.
Sew or glue the wig onto the head. Braid the hair strands into a braid.

Fringe (do not stuff, make 2)
Rnd 1: 7 sc in MR (7)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (14)
Rnds 3-4: sc in each st around (14)
Rnd 5: *5 sc, dec* x2 (12)
Rnds 6-7: sc in each st around (12)
Rnd 8: *4 sc, dec* x2 (10)
Rnd 9: sc in each st around (10)
Rnd 10: *3 sc, dec* x2 (8)
Rnds 11-13: sc in each st around (8)
Rnd 14: 4 dec, 1 sl st (4). Fasten off. Sew or glue onto the head.
patterns.notes: Light orange / ginger color for hair. The 3 long chain strands are braided into Jessie's signature braid.

patterns.englishText:
Jessie Amigurumi Doll — Ears & Hat

Ears
MR, 6 sc, 1 sl st (6). Leave a long tail for sewing.

Hat
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *sc, inc*, rep around (18)
Rnd 4: *2 sc, inc*, rep around (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc*, rep around (30)
Rnd 6: 2 sc, inc, *4 sc, inc* x5, 2 sc (36)
Rnd 7: *5 sc, inc*, rep around (42)
Rnd 8: 3 sc, inc, *6 sc, inc* x5, 3 sc (48)
Rnd 9: sc in BLO of each st around (48)
Rnds 10-11: sc in each st around (48)
Rnd 12: sc in FLO of each st around (48)
Rnd 13: *7 sc, inc*, rep around (54)
Rnd 14: 4 sc, inc, *8 sc, inc* x5, 4 sc (60)
Rnd 15: *9 sc, inc*, rep around (66)
Rnd 16: 5 sc, inc, *10 sc, inc* x5, 5 sc (72)
Rnd 17: *11 sc, inc*, rep around (78)
Rnd 18: 78 sl st around. Fasten off.
Embroider the hat as shown in the photo.
patterns.notes: Ears in skin color. Hat in red with white embroidered detail along the brim. The BLO round (Rnd 9) and FLO round (Rnd 12) create the fold for the hat brim.

patterns.englishText:
Jessie Amigurumi Doll — Body

Body (stuff as you go)
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *sc, inc*, rep around (18)
Rnd 4: *2 sc, inc*, rep around (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc*, rep around (30)
Rnd 6: *4 sc, inc*, rep around (36)
Rnd 7: sc in each st around (36)
Change to ecru.
Rnd 8: 36 sl st in BLO around (36)
Rnd 9: 36 sc in BLO around (36)
Rnds 10-12: sc in each st around (36)
Rnd 13: *4 sc, dec* x6 (30)
Change to yellow.
Rnd 14: sc in each st around (30)
Rnd 15: *3 sc, dec* x6 (24)
Rnd 16: sc in each st around (24)
Rnd 17: *2 sc, dec* x6 (18)
Change to skin.
Rnd 18: 18 sc in BLO around (18)
Rnd 19: *sc, dec* x6 (12)
Rnds 20-26: sc in each st around (12)
Fasten off and cinch the remaining sts closed with a tapestry needle.
Collar trim: working into the front loops left from Rnd 18, *ch 2, sc* x18 around. Fasten off.
patterns.notes: Color sequence bottom to top: blue (Rnds 1-7), ecru/white shirt (Rnds 8-12), yellow stripe (Rnds 14-16), then skin for the neck. The (ch 2, sc) x18 round adds a small ruffled collar at the neckline.

patterns.englishText:
Jessie Amigurumi Doll — Joining Head & Body (Assembly)

Assembly
Working into Rnd 8 as shown in the photo: 36 sc around. Fasten off.
Attach the head to the body: take the needle in through one side of the neck and out the other side, then bring it out through the top of the head. Repeat this 3 times, then knot a few times on top of the head and secure.
patterns.chineseText: 组装页（多为图片）。说明文字：照片第8行处入针 36sc 断线。把身体装进头：从一侧脖子穿入、另一侧穿出，最后从头顶穿出，重复3次，在头顶打几个结固定。
patterns.notes: Assembly / joining page, mostly step photos. Sew the head firmly onto the neck tube before adding hair.

patterns.englishText:
Jessie Amigurumi Doll — Legs / Boots

Legs (stuff as you go; make 2)
Rnd 1: ch 5, starting from the 2nd ch: inc, 2 sc, W (3 sc in one st) at the tip, 3 sc, then continue around the other side (10)
Rnd 2: *2 inc, 3 sc* x2 (14)
Rnd 3: sc in BLO of each st around (14)
Rnd 4: sc in each st around (14)
Rnd 5: 6 sc, *dec, sc* x2, 2 sc (12)
Rnd 6: 4 sc, 4 dec (8)
Change to ecru.
Rnd 7: sc in each st around (8)
Rnd 8: *3 sc, inc* x2 (10)
Change to blue.
Rnd 9: *4 sc, inc* x2 in BLO (12)
Rnd 10: 2 sc, dec, 4 sc, dec, 2 sc (10)
Rnd 11: 2 sc, 1 sl st. Leave a long tail for sewing.
Boot cuff trim: working into Rnd 9 as shown in the photo —
Rnd 1: 10 sc, 1 sl st, ch 1
Rnd 2: 2 sc, inc, 4 sc, inc, 2 sc (12), 1 sl st, ch 1
Rnd 3: 12 sc, 1 sl st. Fasten off.
Embroider the boots as shown in the photo.
patterns.chineseText: LEGS（腿，边钩边填充）：1- 起5ch,从第2针开始;1inc,2sc,1W,3sc=10；2-(2inc,3sc)*2=14；3- Blo 14sc；4=14；5- 6sc,(1dec,1sc)*2,2sc=12；6- 4sc,4dec=8；换米白色；7=8；8-(3sc,1inc)*2=10；换蓝色；9- Blo(4sc,1inc)*2=12；10- 2sc,1dec,4sc,1dec,2sc=10；11=2sc,1slst 留长线缝合。照片第9行处入针:1=10sc,1slst,Ch1；2- 2sc,1inc,4sc,1inc,2sc=12,1slst,Ch1；3=12sc,1slst 断线。照片样在腿上绣线。
patterns.notes: Brown boot toe, ecru/white sole accent, blue jeans/cuff. Make 2. The W stitch (3 sc in one stitch) shapes the toe of the oval-soled boot.

patterns.englishText:
Jessie Amigurumi Doll — Arms

Arms (do not stuff, make 2)
Rnd 1: 8 sc in MR (8)
Rnd 2: sc in each st around (8)
Rnd 3: *2 sc, dec* x2 (6)
Change to ecru.
Rnd 4: 6 sl st in BLO around (6)
Rnd 5: 6 sc in BLO around (6)
Rnds 6-10: sc in each st around (6), 1 sl st. Leave a long tail for sewing.
Embroider the belt as shown in the photo. The doll (Jessie) is now finished.
patterns.chineseText: ARMS（手臂，不填充，做2个）：1- MR 8sc；2=8；3-(2sc,1dec)*2=6；换米白色；4- Blo 6slst；5- Blo 6sc；6-10=6sc,1slst 留长线缝合。照片样绣腰带。成品：杰西完成。
patterns.notes: Skin then ecru/white sleeve. Make 2. Finishing: embroider the brown belt across the body; assemble all parts. Done.

meta.intro: A crocheted Jessie doll inspired by the cowgirl character from Toy Story, worked in amigurumi style as a soft collectible figure. It makes a fun handmade gift for fans and a cheerful shelf or playroom display.

faq.question: What kind of yarn works best for an amigurumi doll like this?
faq.answer: The pattern does not state a yarn. A smooth worsted or DK acrylic is a common choice for character dolls because it holds stitch definition and comes in a wide color range for the outfit and hair.

faq.question: How do I stop stuffing from showing through the doll?
faq.answer: Use a hook a size or two smaller than your yarn's label recommends. The tighter fabric keeps the stuffing hidden and gives the doll a firm, even shape.

patterns.englishText:
Office-Worn-Out Fish — Body, Arms, Feet & Trouser Legs

US terms. Shorthand: X=sc, V=inc, A=dec, CH=ch.

Body (1.8 mm, indigo #46):
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR, indigo (6)
Rnd 2: inc in each st (12)
Rnd 3: *sc, inc* around (18)
Rnd 4: *sc, inc, sc* around (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc* around (30)
Rnd 6: *2 sc, inc, 2 sc* around (36)
Rnd 7-11: sc around (36)
Rnd 12: change to amber-yellow #48, sc around (36)
Rnd 13-39: sc around (36)
Rnd 40: *2 sc, dec, 2 sc* around (30)
Rnd 41: sc around (30)
Rnd 42: *3 sc, dec* around (24)
Rnd 43: *sc, dec, sc* around (18)
Rnd 44: *sc, dec* around (12)
Rnd 45: dec around, fasten off and close (6)

Left arm (1.8 mm, amber-yellow #48):
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2-8: sc around (6)
Rnd 9: dec, 4 sc (5)
Rnd 10-13: sc around (5)
Rnd 14: dec, 3 sc (4)
Rnd 15-18: sc around (4)

Right arm (1.8 mm, amber-yellow #48):
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2-9: sc around (6)
Rnd 10: dec, 4 sc (5)
Rnd 11-15: sc around (5)
Rnd 16: dec, 3 sc (4)
Rnd 17-21: sc around (4)

Foot (x2) (1.8 mm, amber-yellow #48):
Rnd 1: Ch 3, working back from 2nd ch from hook: sc, inc, sc (4)
Rnd 2: 3 sc, inc (5)
Rnd 3-5: sc around (5)
Rnd 6: dec, 3 sc (4)
Rnd 7-10: sc around (4)
After finishing, glue a pipe-cleaner/armature wire into the center of each foot with hot glue; set aside.

Left trouser leg (1.8 mm, indigo #46):
Rnd 1: Ch 7, join into a ring (7)
Rnd 2-16: sc around (7)

Right trouser leg (1.8 mm, indigo #46):
Rnd 1: Ch 7, join into a ring (7)
Rnd 2-11: sc around (7)
Slip each wired foot into a trouser leg, leaving about 6 rows of the foot exposed, then glue or sew the foot and trouser leg together.

patterns.notes: An amigurumi 'tired office worker' fish. Yarn: 4-ply milk cotton (萌娃娃四股) in colorways 29 milk-tea, 33 grey, 34 black, 46 indigo, 48 amber-yellow, 51 cream. Hooks: 1.8 mm and 1.5 mm. Body changes from indigo to amber-yellow at Rnd 12. Feet are stiffened with armature wire. Note from maker: the two arms differ slightly in length.

patterns.englishText:
Office-Worn-Out Fish — Eyes, Eyelids, Belt, Fin, Laptop & Mouth

US terms. Shorthand: X=sc, W/V=inc, T=tr, F=hdc, E=sl st, sl=sl st.

Eye (x2) (1.8 mm, cream #51, wrong side facing out):
Row 1: Ch 4, working back from 2nd ch from hook: 2 sc, inc, sc, inc
Row 2: inc, sc, 3 inc, sc, 2 inc

Eyelid (x2) (amber-yellow #48 split to 2 plies, 1.5 mm):
Rnd 1: 5 sc in MR; do not join, turn and work flat
Row 2: inc, 3 sc, inc
Row 3: inc, 5 sc, inc
Row 4: work 1 row of sc along the flat (straight) edge

Belt (1.8 mm, black #34):
Chain a length to fit around the body, join into a ring; 2nd round sc around.

Belt buckle (1.8 mm, grey #33):
Ch 3, working back from 2nd ch from hook: 2 sc.

Fin (1.8 mm, amber-yellow #48):
Ch 24, working back from 2nd ch from hook: sl st, sc, 3 tr, 4 hdc, 5 sl st, 4 hdc, 3 tr, sc, sl st

Laptop (x2) (1.8 mm, worked flat, grey #33):
Row 1: Ch 18, sc back across (17)
Row 2-11: sc across (17)
Then ch 1 to turn, inc, and work sc once around the remaining 3 sides, working inc (W) at each corner. Leave a long tail on one piece; glue a piece of felt to the inside center to give the laptop some dimension, then sew the two pieces together.

Mouth (1.8 mm, milk-tea #29):
Ch 30, join into a ring; glue on with the wrong side facing out.

Eyebrows: cut shapes from black felt and glue on (the maker forgot to add eyebrows).
patterns.chineseText:
眼睛×2(1.8mm)51号乳白(反面朝外): 1:4ch,倒2回钩2X,W,X,V 2:V,X,3V,X,2V
眼皮×2 48号秋黄色拆两股(1.5mm): 1:环起5X,不引拔翻立片钩 2:V,3X,V 3:V,5X,V 4:沿着平的那一边钩一行X
腰带(1.8mm)34号黑色: 自己比着主体大小钩适当长度的ch然后首尾连接, 第二圈钩X
腰带扣(1.8mm)33号灰色 3ch倒二回钩2x
鱼鳍(1.8mm)48号秋黄: 24ch, 倒二回钩sl, X, 3T, 4F, 5E, 4F, 3T, X, sl
电脑×2(1.8mm)完美片钩 33号灰色: 1:18ch回钩17X 2-11:17X 然后立一针起立针, W, 再绕着剩下3边绕一圈X, 每个转角处都钩W, 其中一片留长线, 在内侧中间贴上不织布, 让电脑看起来立体一点, 再把两片缝合在一起
嘴巴(1.8mm)29号奶茶色: 30ch连接成圈, 反面朝外粘贴
眉毛可以用黑色不织布修剪出形状粘贴哈, 我忘记贴眉毛了
patterns.notes: Second page of the 'tired office worker' fish amigurumi. Yarn: 4-ply milk cotton in colorways 51 cream (eyes), 48 amber-yellow (eyelids/fin), 34 black (belt), 33 grey (buckle/laptop), 29 milk-tea (mouth). Hooks: 1.8 mm and 1.5 mm. Eyes are worked wrong-side-out. Laptop is two flat panels sewn together with felt inside for dimension.

meta.intro: A humorous crocheted fish amigurumi, a small soft figure with playful character appeal. It works well as a desk companion, keychain charm, or quirky handmade gift.

faq.question: Is this a good project for a beginner amigurumi maker?
faq.answer: Small fish amigurumi are usually beginner-friendly, relying mainly on single crochet worked in rounds with simple increases and decreases for the body shaping.

faq.question: What yarn and hook should I use?
faq.answer: The pattern does not specify materials. A worsted or DK acrylic with a slightly smaller hook than the label suggests gives a tight, stuffing-proof fabric typical of amigurumi.

patterns.englishText:
Crochet Elephant — Head, Body, Arms, Legs, Trunk & Ears

US terms. Shorthand: x=sc, v=inc, a=dec, k=incomplete loop on hook (for the popcorn group), t=dc, sl=sl st.

Head:
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc in each st (12)
Rnd 3: *sc, inc* around (18)
Rnd 4: *2 sc, inc* around (24)
Rnd 5-6: sc around (24)
Rnd 7: 7 sc, 3 inc, 4 sc, 3 inc, 7 sc (30)
Rnd 8-9: sc around (30)
Rnd 10: 7 sc, 3 dec, 4 sc, 3 dec, 7 sc (24)
Rnd 11: *2 sc, dec* around (18)
Rnd 12: *sc, dec* around (12)

Body:
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc in each st (12)
Rnd 3: *sc, inc* around (18)
Rnd 4: *2 sc, inc* around (24)
Rnd 5: sc around (24)
Rnd 6: 6 sc, 2 dec, 4 sc, 2 dec, 6 sc (20)
Rnd 7: 6 sc, dec, 4 sc, dec, 6 sc (18)
Rnd 8: sc around (18)
Rnd 9: *sc, dec* around (12)
Rnd 10-12: sc around (12)

Arm (x2):
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: *2 sc, inc* twice (8)
Rnd 3: *2 sc, dec* twice (6)
Rnd 4-7: sc around (6)

Leg (x2):
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6) (you may use a pre-made base/萌仔仔 here)
Rnd 2: inc in each st (12)
Rnd 3: 4 sc, 2 dec, 4 sc (10)
Rnd 4: sc around (10)
Rnd 5: 4 sc, dec, 4 sc (9)
Rnd 6: sc around (9)
Rnd 7: *sc, dec* 3 times (6)
Rnd 8: sc around (6)

Trunk:
Rnd 1-5: 6 sc each round (6)
Rnd 6: *2 sc, inc* twice (8)
Rnd 7: 8 sc around (8)

Ear (x2):
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc in each st (12)
Rnd 3: *sc, inc* around (18)
Rnd 4: *2 sc, inc* around (24)
Rnd 5: 6 sc, then 3 times [incomplete loop, (5 dc), incomplete loop, sl st], 6 sc
patterns.notes: Yarn: fur/eyelash yarn. Hook: 6.0 mm. Shorthand: x = sc, v = inc, a = dec, t = dc, sl = sl st; k marks incomplete loops held on the hook for the shell/popcorn edging on the ears. Legs can start from a pre-made amigurumi base. Stuff the head and body firmly.

author: 正在拍照的xmw

patterns.englishText:
Pear Pattern
Body:
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: Inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: *Sc, inc* x6 (18)
Rnd 4: *2 sc, inc* x6 (24)
Rnd 5: *3 sc, inc* x6 (30)
Rnds 6-10: Sc in each st around (30)
Rnd 11: *3 sc, dec* x6 (24)
Rnds 12-14: Sc in each st around (24)
Rnd 15: *2 sc, dec* x6 (18)
Rnds 16-18: Sc in each st around (18)
Rnd 19: *Sc, dec* x6 (12)
Rnd 20: Dec x6, fasten off

Leaf: Ch start, gradient dc
Stem: Ch, sc tube
patterns.notes: Pear amigurumi. Clear redrawn pattern diagram.

meta.intro: A plump little crocheted pear worked in continuous rounds with a simple leaf and stem. This sweet fruit amigurumi makes a charming bowl filler, photo prop, or quick handmade gift.

faq.question: How is the pear's shape created?
faq.answer: The body increases to 30 stitches over the first five rounds, holds steady through Rnd 10, then decreases in stages (Rnds 11, 15, 19-20) to form the rounded bottom and narrower top of a pear.

faq.question: When should I stuff the pear?
faq.answer: Add fiberfill gradually as you work the decrease rounds, packing firmly before you close the final 6 stitches with the Rnd 20 fasten-off so the shape stays plump.

faq.question: How do I attach the leaf and stem?
faq.answer: The stem is a short chain worked into a single-crochet tube and the leaf is a chained piece with gradient double crochets; sew both to the top center of the pear once the body is closed.

author: 刀刀和舟舟

patterns.englishText:
Witch Doll Dress — Bodice, Skirt, Sleeves & Collar

Dress (worked top-down):
Row 1: Ch 17, sc in 2nd ch from hook and across (16). Divide the 16 sc into 2 x 6 + 4: one section each for the left and right front, one for each sleeve opening, two for the back, plus 1 st at each of the 4 corners. Join first and last to work in the round.
Rnd 2: sc in each sc; at each of the 4 corners work (sc, ch 2, sc) (4 corners)
Rnd 3-7: sc in each sc; into each corner ch-2 space work (sc, ch 2, sc)
Rnd 8: sc in each st around; when you reach corner 1, sc, ch 3, then skip directly across to corner 2 and sc; treat corners 3 and 4 the same way. Sleeves are now separated from the body.
Rnd 9: sc in each st around
Rnd 10: 2 dc in each st around
Rnd 11-19: dc in each st around
Rnd 20: sc in each st, ch 2 (picot/edging)

Sleeve (x2):
Rnd 1: sc in each st around
Rnd 2: sl st in each st around

Collar:
Starting at the center back, work: sc, dc, hdc, 2 sl st, hdc, dc, 2 sc, dc, hdc, 2 sl st, hdc, dc, sc
patterns.chineseText:
连衣裙:
R1: 起17ch, 倒2勾16x, 分成2*6份+4(左右前片各1份, 两只袖口各1份, 后背2份, 4个转角各1针), 首尾相连成环
R2: 短针的位置勾短针, 4个转角的位置勾(1x,2ch,1x)
R3-R7: 短针的位置勾短针, 每个转角的2ch空里勾(1x,2ch,1x)
R8: 每个针目勾1x, 到第1转角时勾1x, 勾3ch, 直接到第2转角勾1x, 第3、4转角同理。这里就完成分袖了。
R9: 每个针目勾1x
R10: 每个针目勾2t
R11-R19: 每个针目勾1t
R20: 每个针目勾1x, 2ch
袖子:
R1: 每个针目勾1x
R2: 每个针目勾1引拔针
领子: 从后背中间起针, 勾1x,1t,1f,2e,1f,1t,2x,1t,1f,2e,1f,1t,1x
patterns.notes: Part of the Little Witch doll outfit. Yarn: size 8 lace thread, colorway 610 for the dress. Hook: 1.0 mm. Shorthand: x = sc, t = dc, f = hdc, e = sl st. Dress is worked as a top-down yoke; Rnd 8 separates the sleeves, then the skirt is worked in dc.

patterns.englishText:
Witch Doll Accessories — Bag & Bow

Bag:
(I started with ch 13 but it felt a bit big, so the pattern is given with ch 11)
Rnd 1: Ch 11, working back from 2nd ch from hook: inc, 8 sc, inc (12)
Rnd 2: 3 inc, 8 sc, 3 inc (working around the foundation chain)
Rnd 3-10: sc in each st around
Row 11: Fold the bag flat, find the two end stitches, start at one side and sc across to the other side (this forms the flap base)
Row 12-16: Turn the work, dec 1 at the start, then sc across (decrease 1 each row; on row 14 leave 4 sts open in the very center as a buttonhole)
Finally sc 1 round all around the flap edge.

Button: 6 sc in a magic ring; Rnd 2: 6 inc; sew it to the center front of the bag.

Strap: sc 1 at one end, ch 40, sc 1 into the other end, then sl st back across all 40 chains, returning to the start; sl st to finish.

Bow:
Row 1: Ch 11, dc in 2nd ch from hook and across (10 dc)
Row 2-20: dc in each st, working back and forth in rows; finally sew the last row to the first to form a loop.
Pinch the center tight and sew to create the bow shape. Lastly, separately ch 100 and sl st back across; use it to cinch the bow center and sew the ends into a headband.
patterns.chineseText:
包包:
(我起了13ch, 但是感觉有点大, 图解就改成11ch了)
R1: 起11ch, 倒2勾w, 8x, w
R2: 勾3v, 8x, 3v
R3-R10: 一个针目勾1x
R11: 对折包包, 找到两端的两针, 从一侧起针, 勾短针到另一侧
R12-R16: 翻转织片, 先勾一个减针, 然后继续勾短针(每一行减一针, 第14行最中间需要4针预留扣眼)
最后沿着包包盖子勾1圈短针
扣子: 环起6x, 第二圈勾6v, 缝合再包包中间
包带: 从一端起1x, 然后勾40ch, 到另一端勾1x, 再倒回勾40引拔针, 回到起针的位置勾引拔针结束
蝴蝶结:
R1: 起11ch, 倒2勾10t
R2-R20: 每个针目勾1t, 来回片勾, 最后和第一行缝合成环
把中间捏紧缝起来, 这样就会有蝴蝶结的形状。最后再另起100ch, 倒回勾引拔针, 然后把蝴蝶结捆起来, 两端缝合成发带。
patterns.notes: Part of the Little Witch doll outfit. Yarn: size 8 lace thread, colorway 103 for the bow, 306 for the bag. Hook: 1.0 mm. Shorthand: x = sc, t = dc, w/v = inc. Bow can also be used as a hair band.

faq.question: Should I start with a 7 or 8 stitch magic ring?
faq.answer: Either works, per the pattern notes. Use 7 for a slightly slimmer body or 8 for a touch more width; the rest of the rounds stay at the same low stitch count.

faq.question: How are the color changes arranged?
faq.answer: The body works in bands: the first rounds in one accent color, a light-gray round, the main color through Rnd 15, then a second accent color for Rnds 16-21 before closing.

faq.question: How do I close the body neatly?

author: 小红帽手作

patterns.englishText:
Crochet Star Cup Cozy — Assembly & Net Bag

Joining the two stars:
Place the two star pieces with right sides facing each other. Working through both layers around the outermost edge, sc all the way around (leave a small opening to turn it right side out).

Net bag (worked from the joined edge):
Ch 12, then sc 1 into the 5th stitch along; *ch 12, skip 5 sts, sc 1*, repeat around to build the netting.
patterns.chineseText: 2片星星面对面，最外圈钩短针。接着钩网兜，12锁针，每隔5个针目，钩1短针。
patterns.notes: Yarn: milk cotton (萌娃娃二号), colorway 18 light yellow. Hook: 2.0 mm. Make two star pieces, hold them right sides together, sc around the outer edge leaving an opening to turn, then continue with the net-bag section.

patterns.englishText:
Crochet Stars — Five Sizes

US terms. Shorthand: x=sc, F=hdc, T=tr, E=sl st, w=inc, k=incomplete hdc (yarn over, pull up a loop), sl=sl st.

Star 3.4 cm:
Rnd 1: 15 hdc in a magic ring (15)
Rnd 2: *ch 5, working back from the 2nd ch from hook: sc, tr, hdc, sl st, then yarn over twice & pull up loops (k2), sl st*, repeat 5 times to form 5 points

Star 3.5 cm:
Ch 61. Working back from the 2nd ch from hook, repeat 5 times: 11 sc, then inc (w). (forms 5 points)

Star 4.0 cm:
Rnd 1: ch 3, 2 hdc, ch 1, then *3 hdc, ch 1* 4 times
Rnd 2: sl st over to the 2nd hdc, then in each ch-space of Rnd 1 work (2 hdc, sl st, ch 3, sl st, 2 hdc); repeat in all 5 ch-spaces

Star 5.2 cm:
Rnd 1: in a magic ring work *hdc, ch 1* 10 times (10 hdc, 10 ch-1 spaces)
Rnd 2: in each ch-1 space of the previous round, make 4 incomplete hdc then yarn over and draw through all loops at once (puff), ch 3, move to next space and repeat; 10 puff groups total
Rnd 3: working into the ch-3 spaces, *sc, then (tr, 2 hdc, sl st, ch 3, sl st, 2 hdc, tr)*, repeat 5 times to form 5 points

Star 5.6 cm:
Rnd 1: ch 3, then *3 hdc, ch 3* 5 times
Rnd 2: in each large ch-space, work (3 hdc, ch 3, 3 hdc); repeat 5 times
Rnd 3: *sc, then in each large ch-space work (4 hdc, ch 3, 4 hdc)*, repeat 5 times
patterns.chineseText:
5种星星图解:
3.4cm: R1:15F  R2:【5ch, 倒2回钩(x, T, F, E, k2, sl)】*5
3.5cm: 61ch, 倒2回钩5(11x, w)
4.0cm: R1:3ch,2F, ch, 4(3F, ch)  R2:【sl到第二个F上, 在R1的ch上钩(2F, E, 3ch, E, 2F)】*5
5.2cm: R1.环起10*(F,1ch)  R2.在上一圈1ch洞里钩4个未完成中长针, 一次性钩出所有线圈锁一针, 3ch, 到下一个洞里重复钩织, 共10组  R3.在第二圈3ch洞里钩织, (x),(T,2F,E,3ch,E,2F,T)*5
5.6cm: R1:3ch,5(3F.3ch)  R2:大洞内(3F,3ch,3F)*5  R3:[x, 大洞内(4F,3ch,4F)]*5
patterns.notes: Five star sizes given: 3.4 cm, 3.5 cm, 4.0 cm, 5.2 cm, 5.6 cm. The 3.5 cm version is a chain-based star ring. Notation: F = hdc, T = tr, E = sl st, w = inc, k = incomplete hdc loop held on hook for a puff.

faq.question: Will this sleeve fit my cup?

author: Amy手工

patterns.englishText:
Vaporeon — Head, Body & Tail

Head (alternate Blue and Light Blue):
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc, (sc, sc), inc... worked as 4 inc, (sc, sc), inc across (12)
Rnd 3: sc, inc, (sc, inc) x3, (sc, inc) x2 (18)
Rnd 4: 2 sc, inc, (2 sc, inc) x2, sc, (sc, sc), (2 sc, inc) x2 (24)
Rnd 5: 24 sc (24)
Rnd 6: 3 sc, (sc, dec) x6, 3 sc, (3 sc, inc) x2 (30)
Rnd 7: 30 sc (30)
Rnd 8-9: 30 sc (30)
Place eyes between Rnd 8-9, 5 sts apart.
Rnd 10: (3 sc, dec) x6 — decreasing toward (12)
Rnd 11: (2 sc, dec) x6 (18)
Rnd 12: (sc, dec) x6 (12)
Fasten off, stuff.

Body (Light Blue):
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: (sc, inc) x6 (18)
Rnd 4: (2 sc, inc, sc, bobble, inc) x2, (2 sc, inc) x2 (24)
Rnd 5: (2 sc, dec) x6 (18)
Rnd 6: 6 sc, bobble, sc, bobble, 9 sc (18)
Rnd 7: (sc, dec) x6 (12)

Tail (Light Blue):
Rnd 1: 4 sc in MR (4)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (8)
Rnd 3: (3 sc, inc) x2 (10)
Rnd 4: 5 dec (5)
Make two of the above, join with sl st and continue.
Rnd 5: 5 sc, 2 dec, sc, 2 dec (6)
Rnd 6: 6 sc (6)
Rnd 7: (sc, inc) x3 (9)
Rnd 8: (2 sc, inc) x3 (12)
Sew tail to body between Rnd 3-5.
patterns.notes: Part of a 10-piece mini Pokémon (Eeveelutions) plush set. Made in chenille/velvet yarn. Head and body use bobble stitches for cheeks/body texture. Colorway: blue and light blue alternating.

patterns.englishText:
Vaporeon — Tail Fin, Head Crest, Side & Front Fins

Tail Fin: Work along tail between Rnd 7-8, in Blue: (sc, sl st) x2, sl st.

Head Crest: Work around the head in White: tr, (hdc, ch 2, sc), sl st; repeat around.

Side Fins (make on both sides of head, inserting between Rnd 6-7, in Blue):
Row 1: ch 7, sc in 2nd ch from hook, 6 sc (6)
Row 2: turn, sl st to head between Rnd 7-8, 6 sc (6)
Row 3: change to Cream, ch 1, [sc, (sc, ch 2, sc)] x2, ch 1

Front Fin (work in center top of head, inserting between Rnd 3-4, in Blue):
Row 1: ch 6, sc in 2nd ch from hook, 5 sc (5)
Row 2: turn, sl st to head between Rnd 2-3, 5 sc (5)
Row 3: turn, change to Cream, ch 1, 4 sc (4)
Row 4: turn, sl st to head between Rnd 1-2, ch 1, 3 sc (3)
Row 5: turn, ch 1, 2 sc (2)
patterns.chineseText: 尾棘: 在尾巴R7-8之间钩 蓝色(X,SL)*2,SL. 头棘: 用白色沿头部一圈钩 T,(F,2CH,X),SL循环. 侧翼: 用蓝色在头两侧R6-7之间入针钩 R1: 7CH倒2勾6X; R2: 翻转引拔到头R7-8之间钩6X; R3: 换米色K1,[X,(X,2CH,X)]*2,K1. 前翼: 用蓝色在头顶中间R3-4入针钩 R1: 6CH倒2勾5X; R2: 翻转引拔到头R2-3之间钩5X; R3: 翻转换米色K1,4X; R4: 翻转引拔到头R1-2之间钩K1,3X; R5: 翻转K1,2X.
patterns.notes: Vaporeon fins and crest are worked directly onto the assembled head/tail. Fins worked flat in rows. Cream tips on side and front fins.

patterns.englishText:
Espeon — Head, Body, Ears, Tail & Forehead Gem

Head (Purple):
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: (sc, inc) x6 (18)
Rnd 4: (2 sc, inc) x6 (24)
Rnd 5: 24 sc (24)
Rnd 6: (3 sc, inc) x6 (30)
Rnd 7-9: 30 sc (30)
Place eyes between Rnd 8-9, 5 sts apart.
Rnd 11: (2 sc, dec) x6 (18)
Rnd 12: (sc, dec) x6 (12)

Body (Purple):
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: (sc, inc) x6 (18)
Rnd 4: (2 sc, inc, sc, bobble, inc) x2, (2 sc, inc) x2 (24)
Rnd 5: (2 sc, dec) x5, 2 sc, dec (18)
Rnd 6: 6 sc, bobble, sc, bobble, 9 sc (18)
Rnd 7: (sc, dec) x6 (12)

Ears (make 2; alternate Purple and Dark Blue):
Rnd 1: 4 sc in MR (4)
Rnd 2: (sc, inc) x2 (6)
Rnd 3: 2 sc, (sc, sc), 2 sc, inc (8)
Rnd 4: 3 sc, inc, 3 sc, inc (10)
Rnd 5: 3 sc, inc, sc, 3 sc, inc, sc (12)
Rnd 6: 3 sc, inc, sc, inc, 3 sc, inc, sc, inc (14)
Rnd 7-8: 16 sc (16)
Rnd 9: 3 sc, 2 sc, inc, 2 sc, 5 sc, inc, 2 sc (18)
Rnd 10-11: 18 sc (18)
Sew ears to head between Rnd 3-7.

Tail: Insert at back between Rnd 3-5, ch 19, sc in 2nd ch from hook, 18 sc; at the tip (sts 6-7) make a fork: ch 7, sc in 2nd ch from hook, 6 sc.

Forehead Gem: 6 sc in MR in Red; attach to head between Rnd 5-6.
patterns.notes: Espeon (purple Eeveelution). Bobble stitches mark the body. Ears are two-tone (purple/dark blue). Red magic-ring disc is the forehead gem. Forked tail.

patterns.englishText:
Espeon Whiskers & Flareon — Ears and Head Tuft

Espeon Whiskers (make 2; Purple):
Rnd 1: 3 sc in MR (3)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (6)
Rnd 3: (sc, inc) x3 (9)
Rnd 4: (sc, dec) x3 (6)
Rnd 5-6: 6 sc (6)
Then ch 2, sc in 2nd ch from hook (sl st), sc. Attach whiskers to both sides of head at Rnd 8.

Flareon: Head and Body Rnd 1-5 follow the universal base pattern; for Body switch to Brown yarn at Rnd 6-7.

Ears (make; alternate Black and Red):
Rnd 1: 4 sc in MR (4)
Rnd 2: sc, (sc, sc), sc, inc (6)
Rnd 3: 2 sc, inc, 2 sc, inc (8)
Rnd 4: 2 sc, inc, sc, 2 sc, inc, sc (10)
Rnd 5: 2 sc, inc, sc, inc, 2 sc, inc, sc, inc (14)
Rnd 6: 2 sc, dec, sc, dec, 2 sc, dec, sc, dec (10)
Rnd 7: 2 sc, dec, sc, 2 sc, dec, sc (8)
Rnd 8: 2 sc, dec, sc, dec (6)
Sew ears to head between Rnd 4-5.

Head Tuft (Brown):
Rnd 1: 4 sc in MR (4)
Rnd 2: (sc, inc) x2 (6)
Rnd 3: (2 sc, inc) x2 (8)
Rnd 4: sc, inc, (dc, dc inc) x2, sc, inc (12)
Rnd 5: (dc, dc inc) x2, 4 sc, (dc, dc inc) x2 (16)
Rnd 6: (sc, dc inc) x4 (12)
Rnd 7: 6 dec (6)
Attach to head between Rnd 2-3.
patterns.chineseText: 胡须*2(Espeon须): R1: 紫色MR3X[3]; R2: 3V[6]; R3: (X,V)*3[9]; R4: (X,A)*3[6]; R5-6: 6X[6]; 2CH倒2勾SL,X. 将胡须固定在头两侧R8. (Flareon/火精灵) 头、身体R1-5图解为通用图解,身体R6-7换棕色线。耳朵(黑色、红色交替钩织): R1: MR4X[4]; R2: X,(X,X),X,V[6]; R3: 2X,V,2X,V[8]; R4: 2X,V,X,2X,V,X[10]; R5: 2X,V,X,V,2X,V,X,V[14]; R6: 2X,A,X,A,2X,A,X,A[10]; R7: 2X,A,X,2X,A,X[8]; R8: 2X,A,X,A[6]; 将耳朵缝合在头R4-5之间。头发: R1: 棕色MR4X[4]; R2: (X,V)*2[6]; R3: (2X,V)*2[8]; R4: X,V,(T,TV)*2,X,V[12]; R5: (T,TV)*2,4X,(T,TV)*2[16]; R6: (X,TV)*4[12]; R7: 6A[6]; 固定在头R2-3之间。
patterns.notes: Two parts on this page: the purple Espeon whiskers (finished above) and Flareon (orange/red Eeveelution). Flareon's head/body use the shared base, switching to brown at the lower body. Ears are black/red two-tone. The fluffy head tuft uses dc and dc-increase for volume.

patterns.englishText:
Flareon Tail & Leafeon — Ears

Flareon Tail (Brown):
Rnd 1: 4 sc in MR (4)
Rnd 2: inc, 2 (tr inc), inc (8)
Rnd 3: sc, inc, (hdc, hdc inc) x2, sc, inc (12)
Rnd 4: (sc, inc) x2, (hdc, hdc inc) x2, (sc, inc) x2 (18)
Rnd 5: 5 sc, (hdc, hdc inc) x4, 5 sc (22)
Rnd 6: (2 dc, 2 inc) x2, 10 sc, (2 dc, tr inc) x2 (26)
Rnd 7: (3 dc, 2 inc) x2, 10 sc, (3 dc, tr inc) x2 (30)
Rnd 8: 30 sc (30)
Rnd 9: 9 sc, 12 dc, 9 sc (30)
Rnd 10: (3 sc, dec) x6 (24)
Rnd 11: (2 sc, dec) x6 (18)
Rnd 12: (sc, dec) x6 (12)
Rnd 13: 6 dec (6)
Sew tail to body between Rnd 3-5.

Leafeon Ears (make 2):
Rnd 1: ch 6, sc in 2nd ch from hook, [4 sc, (sc, ch 2, sl st)] x2 — make 2 in Green and 2 in Brown, then work green and brown held together.
Rnd 2: 4 sc, (sc, 2 sc, inc), 5 sc, dc, (hdc, ch 2, dc), sc
Rnd 3: 4 sc, (sc, 2 inc, sc), 6 sc, dc inc, dc, (hdc, ch 2, ch 1, sc), 2 sc (26)
Head and Body follow the universal base pattern; switch the hands/feet bobble stitches to Brown.
patterns.notes: Flareon's large flame tail is worked with hdc/dc and increases for the fan shape. Leafeon (green leaf Eeveelution) ears are leaf-shaped, worked green and brown held double. Hands/feet bobbles in brown.

patterns.englishText:
Leafeon — Head Leaf & Tail

Head Leaf (Green): ch 2 in MR, 3 hdc, ch 2, 2 hdc, ch 1, sl st. Attach to head between Rnd 4-5.

Tail (worked flat):
Row 1: ch 2 in Cream, sc in 2nd ch from hook (1)
Row 2: turn, Cream, inc (2)
Row 3: turn, Green, 2 sc (2)
Row 4: turn, Green, sc, inc (3)
Row 5: turn, Green, 3 sc (3)
Row 6: turn, Green, 2 sc, inc (4)
Row 7: turn, Green, 4 sc (4)
Row 8: turn, Green, 3 sc, inc (5)
Row 9: turn, Green, 5 sc (5)
Row 10: turn, Green, sk 1, 4 sc (4)
Row 11: turn, Green, sk 1, 3 sc (3)
Row 12: turn, Green, sk 1, 2 sc (2)
Row 13: turn, Green, sk 1, sc (1)
Sew tail to body between Rnd 3-5.
patterns.chineseText: 叶子(Leafeon): 绿色MR2CH,3F,2CH,2F,1CH,SL 固定在头R4-5之间。尾巴(片钩): R1: 米色2CH倒2勾X[1]; R2: 翻转米色V[2]; R3: 翻转绿色2X[2]; R4: 翻转绿色X,V[3]; R5: 翻转绿色3X[3]; R6: 翻转绿色2X,V[4]; R7: 翻转绿色4X[4]; R8: 翻转绿色3X,V[5]; R9: 翻转绿色5X[5]; R10: 翻转绿色K1,4X[4]; R11: 翻转绿色K1,3X[3]; R12: 翻转绿色K1,2X[2]; R13: 翻转绿色K1,X[1]; 将尾巴缝合在身体R3-5之间。
patterns.notes: Leafeon green leaf tail and head sprout, worked flat in rows. Cream base transitioning to green. 'K1' here = skip 1 stitch (decrease at row start to taper the leaf point).

patterns.englishText:
Jolteon — Body Ruff, Tail & Ears

Head and Body Rnd 1-6 follow the universal base pattern.

Body Ruff:
Rnd 7 (front loops only, change to White): [sc, (ch 1, hdc, ch 2, sc in 2nd ch from hook)] x9 — spiky collar.
Rnd 7 (back loops only): (sc, dec) x6 (12)

Tail (Yellow): ch 8, sc in 2nd ch from hook, [(ch 1, hdc, ch 2, sl st in 2nd ch from hook), (sc, ch 2, sl st in 2nd ch from hook) x3, (ch 1, hdc, ch 2, sl st in 2nd ch from hook)] — spiky tail. Sew tail to body between Rnd 3-4.

Ears (make 2; alternate Black and Yellow):
Rnd 1: 4 sc in MR (4)
Rnd 2: sc, (sc, sc), sc, inc (6)
Rnd 3: 2 sc, inc, 2 sc, inc (8)
Rnd 4: 2 sc, sc, inc, 2 sc, sc, inc (10)
Rnd 5: 2 sc, sc, inc, sc, 3 sc, sc, inc (12)
Rnd 6: 2 sc, 2 sc, inc, sc, 4 sc, inc, sc (14)
Rnd 7: 14 sc (14)
Rnd 8: 2 sc, 2 sc, dec, sc, 4 sc, dec, sc (12)
Rnd 9: 2 sc, sc, dec, sc, dec, sc (10)
Rnd 10: 2 sc, dec, sc, 2 sc, dec, sc (8)
Sew ears to head between Rnd 2-3.
patterns.chineseText: (Jolteon/雷精灵) 头、身体R1-6图解为通用图解。身体R7: 换白色外半针[X,(1CH,F,2CH倒2勾X)]*9; R7内半针(X,A)*6[12]. 尾巴: 黄色8CH倒2勾[(1CH,F,2CH倒2勾SL),(X,2CH倒2勾SL)*3,(1CH,F,2CH倒2勾SL)]; 将尾巴缝合在身体R3-4之间。耳朵*2(黑色、黄色交替钩织): R1: MR4X[4]; R2: X,(X,X),X,V[6]; R3: 2X,V,2X,V[8]; R4: 2X,X,V,2X,X,V[10]; R5: 2X,X,V,X,3X,X,V[12]; R6: 2X,2X,V,X,4X,V,X[14]; R7: 2X,5X,7X[14]; R8: 2X,2X,A,X,4X,A,X[12]; R9: 2X,X,A,X,A,X[10]; R10: 2X,A,X,2X,A,X[8]; 将耳朵缝合在头R2-3之间。
patterns.notes: Jolteon (yellow spiky Eeveelution). The white neck ruff and yellow tail are made of spike clusters (hdc/sc with ch loops worked back). Tall black-and-yellow two-tone ears. Ruff worked in front loops, body decrease in back loops of the same round.

patterns.englishText:
Umbreon — Ears & Tail

Head and Body follow the universal base pattern; surface-slip-stitch a yellow ring on the forehead and embroider yellow bands on the hands/feet.

Ears (Dark Grey):
Rnd 1: 4 sc in MR (4)
Rnd 2: (sc, inc) x2 (6)
Rnd 3: (2 sc, inc) x2 (8)
Rnd 4: (3 sc, inc) x2 (10)
Rnd 5: change to Yellow, (4 sc, inc) x2 (12)
Rnd 6: 12 sc (12)
Rnd 7: change to Dark Grey, 12 sc (12)
Rnd 8: (sc, dec) x3 (9)
Rnd 9: 9 sc (9)
Rnd 10: (sc, dec) x3 (6)
Rnd 11: 6 sc (6)
Sew ears to head between Rnd 4-5.

Tail (Dark Grey):
Rnd 1: 4 sc in MR (4)
Rnd 2: (sc, inc) x2 (6)
Rnd 3: sc, hdc, inc, hdc, inc, sc, inc (9)
Rnd 4: change to Yellow, (2 sc, inc) x3 (12)
Rnd 5: change to Dark Grey, sc, inc, hdc, inc, hdc, inc, 6 sc, hdc, inc, hdc (15)
Rnd 6: 5 sc, 4 hdc, 6 sc (15)
Rnd 7: (sc, dec) x5 (10)
Rnd 8: 5 dec (5)
Sew tail to body between Rnd 4-5.
patterns.chineseText: (Umbreon/月精灵) 头、身体图解为通用图解,用黄色在头上引拔圆环,在手脚绣条纹。耳朵: R1: 深灰色MR4X[4]; R2: (X,V)*2[6]; R3: (2X,V)*2[8]; R4: (3X,V)*2[10]; R5: 换黄色(4X,V)*2[12]; R6: 12X[12]; R7: 换深灰色12X[12]; R8: (X,A)*3[9]; R9: 9X[9]; R10: (X,A)*3[6]; R11: 6X[6]; 将耳朵缝合在头R4-5之间。尾巴: R1: 深灰色MR4X[4]; R2: (X,V)*2[6]; R3: X,F,V,F,V,X,V[9]; R4: 换黄色(2X,V)*3[12]; R5: 换深灰色X,V,F,V,F,V,6X,F,V,F[15]; R6: 5X,4F,6X[15]; R7: (X,A)*5[10]; R8: 5A[5]; 将尾巴缝合在身体R4-5之间。
patterns.notes: Umbreon (black/dark-grey moonlight Eeveelution). Yellow rings on ears and tail done as color-change bands; forehead ring is surface slip-stitch; leg bands embroidered. Uses hdc for tail shaping.

patterns.englishText:
Sylveon — Head, Ears & Ribbons

Body follows the universal base pattern; switch hands/feet to Pink.

Head (alternate Pink and White; "black text" sections in White):
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: (sc, inc) x6 (18)
Rnd 4: (2 sc, inc) x6 (24)
Rnd 5: 24 sc (24)
Rnd 6: (3 sc, inc) x6 (30)
Rnd 7-9: 30 sc (30)
Rnd 10: sc, 2 sc, dec, (3 sc, dec) x5 (24)
Rnd 11: (2 sc, dec) x6 (18)
Rnd 12: (sc, dec) x6 (12)

Ears (make 2; alternate Pink and Blue):
Rnd 1: 5 sc in MR (5)
Rnd 2: (sc, inc) x2, sc (7)
Rnd 3: (sc, inc) x3, sc (10)
Rnd 4: (sc, inc) x4, sc, 2 sc (12)
Rnd 5: 12 sc (12)
Rnd 6: 3 sc, inc, 5 sc, inc, 2 sc (14)
Rnd 7: 3 sc, inc, 7 sc, inc, 2 sc (16)
Rnd 8-9: 16 sc (16)
Rnd 10: 3 sc, dec, sc, 5 sc, dec, 3 sc (14)
Rnd 11: 3 sc, dec, 5 sc, dec, 2 sc (12)
Rnd 12: 6 dec (6)
Sew ears to head between Rnd 3-4.

Ribbons:
Row 1: Light Blue, ch 3, sc in 2nd ch from hook, (sc, ch 2, sl st in 2nd ch from hook) x2
Row 2: turn, 2 sc
Row 3: turn, change to Blue, 2 sc
patterns.notes: Sylveon (pink/white fairy Eeveelution). Head is pink and white alternating. Pink/blue two-tone ears. Flowing blue ribbon streamers (continues on next page). Pink hands/feet.

patterns.englishText:
Sylveon Ribbons & Bow / Eevee — Ears

Sylveon Ribbon (continued):
Row 4: turn, change to Blue-Pink, 2 sc
Row 5-11: turn, change to White, 2 sc
Row 12: turn, sk 1, sc
Row 13-15: turn, sc
Sew ribbons onto the ears.

Bow (White): ch 4 in MR, 4 dc, ch 4, sl st, ch 4, 4 dc, ch 4, sl st. Wrap Pink around the center and attach to head.

Sylveon Tail (Pink):
Rnd 1: 4 sc in MR (4)
Rnd 2: (sc, inc) x2 (6)
Rnd 3: sc, 2 hdc, 3 sc (6)
Rnd 4: sc, hdc, hdc inc, hdc, sc, inc (8)
Rnd 5: (3 sc, inc) x2 (10)
Rnd 6: 5 dec (5)
Sew tail to body between Rnd 3-5.

Eevee Ears (make 2; alternate Black and Brown):
Rnd 1: 4 sc in MR (4)
Rnd 2: sc, (sc, sc), sc, inc (6)
Rnd 3: 2 sc, inc, 2 sc, inc (8)
Rnd 4: 2 sc, inc, sc, 2 sc, inc, sc (10)
Rnd 5: 2 sc, inc, sc, inc, 2 sc, inc, sc, inc (14)
Rnd 6: 2 sc, dec, sc, dec, 2 sc, dec, sc, dec (10)
Rnd 7: 2 sc, dec, sc, 2 sc, dec, sc (8)
Rnd 8: 2 sc, dec, sc, dec (6)
Sew ears to head between Rnd 4-5.
Eevee head follows the universal base pattern.
patterns.chineseText: 丝带(Sylveon续): R4: 翻转换蓝粉色2X; R5-11: 翻转换白色2X; R12: 翻转K1,X; R13-15: 翻转X; 将丝带缝合在耳朵上。蝴蝶结: 白色 MR4CH,4T,4CH,SL,4CH,4T,4CH,SL 用粉色在中间缠绕固定在头上。尾巴: R1: 粉色MR4X[4]; R2: (X,V)*2[6]; R3: X,2F,3X[6]; R4: X,F,FV,F,X,V[8]; R5: (3X,V)*2[10]; R6: 5A[5]; 将尾巴缝合在身体R3-5之间。耳朵*2(Eevee/伊布,黑色、棕色交替钩织): R1: MR4X[4]; R2: X,(X,X),X,V[6]; R3: 2X,V,2X,V[8]; R4: 2X,V,X,2X,V,X[10]; R5: 2X,V,X,V,2X,V,X,V[14]; R6: 2X,A,X,A,2X,A,X,A[10]; R7: 2X,A,X,2X,A,X[8]; R8: 2X,A,X,A[6]; 将耳朵缝合在头R4-5之间。头图解为通用图解。
patterns.notes: Two parts: finishing the Sylveon ribbon streamers and white bow, plus Eevee (the brown base form). Eevee ears are black/brown two-tone. Eevee uses the shared base head/body.

patterns.chineseText: 整页为成品实拍图(米黄色小动物玩偶,无图解文字)。
patterns.notes: Finished-plush photo collage only — no pattern instructions on this page.

patterns.englishText:
Glaceon — Body, Ears & Hair

Head follows the universal base pattern.

Body (alternate Light Blue and Blue):
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: inc in each st around (12)
Rnd 3: (sc, inc) x6 (18)
Rnd 4: (2 sc, inc, bobble, inc) x2, (2 sc, inc) x2 (24)
Rnd 5: (2 sc, dec) x5, 2 sc, dec (18)
Rnd 6: 6 sc, bobble, sc, bobble, 5 sc, 4 sc (18)
Rnd 7: sc, dec, (sc, dec) x4, sc, dec (12)

Ears (make 2; alternate Light Blue and Blue):
Rnd 1: 4 sc in MR (4)
Rnd 2: (sc, inc) x2 (6)
Rnd 3: 2 sc, (sc, sc), 2 sc, inc (8)
Rnd 4: 3 sc, inc, 3 sc, inc (10)
Rnd 5: 3 sc, inc, sc, 3 sc, inc, sc (12)
Rnd 6: 3 sc, inc, sc, inc, 3 sc, inc, sc, inc (16)
Rnd 7: 3 sc, dec, sc, dec, 3 sc, dec, sc, dec (12)
Rnd 8: 3 sc, dec, sc, 3 sc, dec, sc (10)
Rnd 9: 3 sc, dec, 3 sc, dec (8)
Rnd 10: (2 sc, dec) x2 (6)
Sew ears to head between Rnd 3-4.

Hair (worked flat):
Row 1: ch 2, sc in 2nd ch from hook
Row 2-3: turn, sc
Row 4: turn, 2 sc
Row 5: turn, 2 sc
Row 6: turn, 2 sc
Row 7: turn, 2 sc, inc
Row 8: turn, 2 sc, inc
Row 9: turn, sk 1, 3 sc
Row 10: turn, sk 1, 2 sc
Row 11: turn, sk 1, sc

faq.question: How do I make the bobble stitch used in the early rounds?

faq.question: When do I change colors?

patterns.englishText:
Simple Coaster

Rnd 1: Ch 3 (counts as dc), 11 dc in MR, sl st to top of ch-3. Fasten off. (12 dc)
Rnd 2: Join yarn, ch 3 (counts as dc), dc in same st, ch 1, *dc-inc in next st, ch 1*, repeat around, sl st to top of ch-3. Fasten off. (24 dc, 12 ch-1 sps)
Rnd 3: Join yarn, ch 3, 2 dc in first ch-1 sp, ch 2, *3 dc in next ch-1 sp, ch 2*, repeat around, sl st to top of ch-3. Fasten off. (36 dc, 12 ch-2 sps)
Rnd 4: Join yarn, ch 3, dc in next st, ch 2, 2 dc in ch-2 sp, *(2 dc, ch 2, 2 dc) in next ch-2 sp*, repeat around, sl st. Fasten off. (48 dc, 12 ch-2 sps)
Rnd 5: Join yarn, ch 3, 6 dc in ch-2 sp (7 dc total with ch-3), sc between the 4-dc groups of Rnd 4, *7 dc in next ch-2 sp, sc between groups*, repeat around, sl st. Fasten off.

Note: Fasten off after each round. Ch 3 at start of each round counts as 1 dc.

patterns.notes: Symbol chart (quarter section shown). Each round is fastened off and rejoined. The ch-3 turning chain counts as 1 dc. Final round creates a scalloped flower edge with 7-dc fan shells separated by sc.

meta.intro: A quick round coaster that grows from a magic ring through five rounds of dc clusters and chain spaces, finishing with a scalloped flower edge of 7-dc fan shells. It's a beginner-friendly project and a satisfying way to use up small amounts of yarn.

faq.question: Does the turning chain count as a stitch?
faq.answer: Yes. The ch-3 worked at the start of each round counts as 1 dc, so you join with a slip stitch to the top of that ch-3 to close each round.

faq.question: Why does the pattern fasten off after every round?
faq.answer: Each round is fastened off and the yarn rejoined for the next, which keeps the rounds tidy and is useful if you want to change colors between rounds.

faq.question: What creates the decorative edge?
faq.answer: The final round forms a scalloped flower border by working 7-dc fan shells into the ch-2 spaces, separated by single crochets between the dc groups of the previous round.

patterns.englishText:
Triomphe Arch Pendant — Handwritten Chart

This is a miniature Celine Triomphe arch charm worked in multiple steps:

1. Ch 2, 4 dc (working back), ch 2, sl st back 5 sts
2. Ch 5, work petal: sl st, hdc, dc, hdc, sl st (repeat for 3 rows)
3. Ch 4, sl st back 4
4. At front of row 3: ch 5
5. Work downward with sl st along 3 rows, ch 4, sl st back down 3 rows
6. Inc across 3 rows (building the arch columns)
7. After ch 5, repeat from beginning for second column; both sides return to first st, 4 dc, sl st
8. Same as back: 3 sts, 5 sts sl st, hdc, dc, hdc, sl st; then skip 3, ch 6, sl st
9. 3 sl st at front, ch toward center on both sides, sl st back 3, 3 sts, fasten off.

Note: This is handwritten and some details are difficult to read precisely. Refer to the original image for the numbered diagram showing part placement.
patterns.chineseText:
凯旋门挂件（手写图解）
★挂绳
① 2个锁针，倒4钩长针，再2个锁针，5倒4引拔
② 3排5个锁针，顺序为：引拔，中长针，长针，中长针，引拔针
③ 勾4个锁针，倒4钩引拔
④ 来到3排前分5个锁针
⑤ 钩下，3排向引拔，勾4倒3排向引拔
⑥ 加针3排
⑦ 5个锁针后，重复开始钩，两侧回到第一个，倒4到长针，引拔
⑧ 同后部3针5针向引拔，中长针，长针，中长针，引拔，再另一个隔3个6钩针，引拔
⑨ 3排前分3个引拔，然后两侧锁针向中，倒向3引拔，3针，结束

patterns.englishText:
Pink Diagonal Stripe Phone Bag

Base (worked in the round along both sides of chain):
Ch 34, turn: 30 dc along chain, dc-inc in last ch (corner), 29 dc along other side, dc-inc (corner) = 64 dc total

Body (diagonal herringbone/FPdc pattern):
Follow the symbol chart for the diagonal stripe pattern using FPdc (Front Post Double Crochet).
Row 1 pattern: 32 sts across, pattern repeat of 12 sts
Row 2: Same as Row 1
Continue in pattern to desired height.

Button Tab:
Ch 11, turn: 6 sc back (6)

Edging:
Follow the scallop/shell border symbol chart along the top edge.

patterns.notes: 2.0mm hook, single strand yarn, 3 gradient pink colors. Base = 64 sts. The diagonal stripe effect is created using FPdc (Front Post Double Crochet) worked in an offset pattern. FW/FV in the base refer to dc-inc at the corners to form the oval/rectangular base.

meta.intro: A soft gradient-pink phone pouch worked in textured diagonal stripes with a button-tab closure and a scalloped top edge. It's a quick, practical accessory that keeps your phone protected and looks pretty clipped to a bag or carried on its own.
materials: Single strand of yarn in 3 gradient pink colors

faq.question: What creates the diagonal stripe texture?
faq.answer: The diagonal effect comes from Front Post Double Crochet (FPdc) worked in an offset pattern over a 12-stitch repeat. Following the symbol chart so the posts shift each round is what produces the slanted ridges.

faq.question: How is the base shaped?
faq.answer: You chain 34 and work double crochet down both sides of the chain with dc-increases at each corner (the FW/FV marks), forming an oval/rectangular base of 64 stitches that the body builds up from.

faq.question: Can I change the bag's height?
faq.answer: Yes. After the base, you simply repeat the diagonal pattern rows until the pouch reaches your desired height before adding the scallop edging and button tab.

title: Rice Ball (make 2 identical pieces)
description:

#钩针小物[话题]# #手工钩织[话题]# #钩针图解[话题]# #钩针玩偶[话题]# #钩织使我快乐[话题]# #织女[话题]#
author: 板栗爱吃草莓🌰

patterns.englishText:
--- Rice Ball (make 2 identical pieces) ---
R1: Ch 10
R2: Sc in 2nd ch from hook, 7 sc, 3 sc in last ch (turn corner), 7 sc along other side, inc in last st (26)
R3: Inc, 7 sc, 3 inc, 7 sc, 2 inc (32)
Make 2 pieces; fasten off one piece, keep yarn attached on the other.
R4: Place pieces together, (BLO) 26 sc through both layers to join
R5-R7: Sc in each st around (26)
Stuff with fiberfill, sew the remaining opening closed.

--- Shrimp ---
With white yarn:
R1: 6 sc in MR (6)
R2: Inc in each st around (12)
R3-R8: Sc in each st around (12)
R9: Dec, 8 sc, dec (10)
R10: Dec, 6 sc, dec (8)
R11: Dec, 4 sc, dec (6)
Change to orange yarn:
R12: Sc in each st around (6)
R13: Inc in each st around (12)
R14: Fold flat, sc through both layers to close (12)

Assembly: Place shrimp on top of rice ball, sew together.
patterns.chineseText:
饭团：
R1: 10CH
R2: 倒2, 8X, W, 7X, V
R3: V, 7X, 3V, 7X, 2V
勾2片，一片断线，一片不断线
R4: blo26X
R5-R7: 26X
塞棉，把勾好的一片缝合上去

甜虾：
R1: 6X
R2: 6V
R3-R8: 12X
R9: A, 8X, A
R10: A, 6X, A
R11: A, 4X, A
换橙色线R12: 6X
R13: 6V
R14: 12X对折缝合
patterns.notes: 3.0mm hook. Colors: white (rice), light pink (rice accent), orange-red (shrimp). W = 3 sc in same st. V = inc. A = dec. BLO = back loop only. Inspired by Jellycat-style sushi amigurumi (tamago/egg sushi).

meta.intro: An adorable amigurumi sushi rice ball topped with a little crocheted shrimp, inspired by Jellycat-style plush sushi. It's a fun, beginner-friendly food piece that makes a cute desk buddy, keychain charm, or gift for sushi lovers.

faq.question: Why do I make two identical rice-ball pieces?
faq.answer: The two oval pieces are placed together and joined with back-loop-only single crochet through both layers, which gives the rice ball its flat, pinched sushi shape rather than a fully round ball.

faq.question: When do I stuff the rice ball?
faq.answer: Stuff with fiberfill after working rounds R4-R7, then sew the remaining opening closed so the piece holds its plump shape.

faq.question: How is the shrimp attached?
faq.answer: The shrimp is worked separately in white then orange, folded flat and closed, then placed on top of the rice ball and sewn in place during assembly.

#钩针挂件[话题]# #地球村[话题]# #钩针图解[话题]# #钩针[话题]# #手工钩织[话题]# #钩织[话题]# #钩织小物[话题]#
author: 柯米嘟嘟

patterns.englishText:
Earth Globe Pattern — Color-coded Amigurumi Chart
Colors: White / Royal Blue / Grass Green / Ginger Yellow

Increase section:
R1: 6 sc in MR (6)
R2: Inc in each st around (12)
R3: *Sc, inc*, repeat around (18)
R4: *2 sc, inc*, repeat around (24)
R5: *3 sc, inc*, repeat around (30)
R6: *4 sc, inc*, repeat around (36)
R7: *5 sc, inc*, repeat around (42)
R8: *6 sc, inc*, repeat around (48)

Body (follow color chart for earth map pattern):
R9-R18: Sc in each st around (48) — change colors per stitch as shown in chart

Decrease section:
R19: *6 sc, dec*, repeat around (42)
R20: *5 sc, dec*, repeat around (36)
R21: *4 sc, dec*, repeat around (30)
R22: *3 sc, dec*, repeat around (24) — begin stuffing
R23: *2 sc, dec*, repeat around (18)
R24: *Sc, dec*, repeat around (12)
R25: *4 sc, dec* (or as charted) — continue stuffing
R26: Dec around, fasten off (6)

Color placement per stitch follows the chart — irregular color changes create the world map continents.
patterns.chineseText:
毛线地球图解（带颜色编排）
颜色：纯白/宝蓝/草绿/姜黄
R1: 6X (6)
R2: 6V (12)
R3: (X, V)×6 (18)
R4: (X, V, X)×6 或类似 (24)
R5: (3X, V)×6 (30)
R6-R7: 继续加针至42-48
R8-R18: 不加不减，按颜色图钩织地球图案
R19起开始减针
R25-R26: 收口
每针的颜色按图中彩色标注排列（绿=草绿，蓝=宝蓝，黄=姜黄，白=纯白）
patterns.notes: 2.0mm hook. 4 colors of yarn (white, royal blue, grass green, ginger yellow). The color chart shows per-stitch color assignments to create a world map pattern. Stuff firmly around the sides to achieve a round shape. Cut connecting threads every 2-3 rounds when changing colors. The increase/decrease structure follows standard amigurumi sphere shaping; the unique aspect is the per-stitch color pattern.

meta.intro: A round amigurumi globe whose continents are formed by per-stitch color changes following a world-map chart. This colorwork sphere makes a charming decorative piece for a shelf, classroom, or anyone who loves geography and travel.

faq.question: How are the continents created?
faq.answer: The sphere itself uses standard amigurumi increase/decrease shaping; the world map comes entirely from changing yarn color per stitch according to the color chart, so the difficulty is in tracking the colorwork rather than the shaping.

faq.question: How do I keep the back of the work tidy when changing colors?
faq.answer: Cut the connecting threads every 2-3 rounds when changing colors so you don't carry long floats across the inside of the globe.

faq.question: How do I get a nicely round shape?
faq.answer: Stuff firmly around the sides as you close the decrease section so the globe holds a smooth, round form rather than collapsing flat.

author: 一颗柠檬🍋

patterns.englishText:
Mini Net Earphone Bag

Main Body:
R1: Ch 61, skip 24, 5 sc, ch 3, skip 3, sc, *(ch 6, skip 6, sc)* repeat 6 times, ch 3, skip 3, 5 sc
R2: (BLO) 5 sc, *(ch 6, skip 6, sc)* repeat 7 times, (BLO) 5 sc
R3: (BLO) 5 sc, starting in ch-1 sp: ch 3, sc, *(ch 6, sc)* repeat 6 times, ch 3, (BLO) 5 sc
Repeat R2-R3 until R19, fasten off.

Bag Opening:
R1: 19 sc (19)
R2: (BLO) 19 sc (19)
R3: (BLO) 19 sc (19)

Strap + Clasp:
Starting from any side of the bag opening:
R1: 3 sc, 5 sc, 8 sc (1 sc in each net hole), 5 sc, 3 sc, ch 30, 3 sc, 5 sc, 8 sc (1 sc in each net hole), 5 sc, 3 sc, ch 30, sl st to first st
R2-3: (BLO) work even around
patterns.chineseText:
钩针mini渔网耳机包
主体：
R1: 61ch, 倒24钩5X, 3CH, K3, X, (6CH, K6, X)6, 3CH, K3, 5X
R2: (离自己远的半针)5X, (6CH, K6, X)7, (离自己远的半针)5X
R3: (离自己远的半针)5X, 开始在锁针1锁钩钩3CH, X, (6CH, X)6, 3CH, (离自己远的半针)5X
重复R2-3钩织到R19行，断线
袋口：
R1: 19X
R2: (离自己远的半针)19X
R3: (离自己远的半针)19X
袋带+扣：
袋口从侧面任意开始钩R1: 3X, 5X, 8X(网兜位置每个洞钩一个短针), 5X, 3X, 30CH, 3X, 5X, 8X(网兜位置每个洞钩一个短针), 5X, 3X, 30CH, 引导至第一针
R2-3: (离自己远的半针)不加不减钩完
patterns.notes: 1.8mm hook, #5 lace thread. Mini net bag for earphones/AirPods. BLO = back loop only throughout most of the pattern.

meta.intro: A delicate open-net mini pouch sized for earphones or AirPods, finished with a clasp strap so it can hang from a bag or keychain. The airy mesh and fine thread give it a dainty, lacy look while still holding small essentials.

faq.question: What forms the net pattern?
faq.answer: The mesh is built by alternating short single-crochet sections with ch-6 loops worked over skipped stitches (the *(ch 6, skip 6, sc)* repeats), creating the open net holes that give the bag its lightweight look.

faq.question: Why is so much of the pattern worked in back loop only?
faq.answer: Back loop only is used through most of the body and opening to create a defined ridge line and a slightly stretchy, structured edge that helps the small bag keep its shape.

faq.question: How is the strap added?
faq.answer: The strap is worked directly from the bag opening, single crocheting around (including one sc into each net hole) and chaining 30 to form the strap loops before joining with a slip stitch.

title: Flower & Bird Scarf
description:
🌸
环形起针

author: 烤个地瓜

patterns.englishText:
Flower & Bird Scarf — Combined reference image.
Left: finished product photo showing the gradient scarf with flower motifs and hummingbird appliques.
Top right: flower motif symbol chart (pink lines).
Bottom right: bird motif symbol chart (blue lines).

Flower: Start with magic ring.
Bird: Hook into the chain stitch positions marked in diagram.

See images 59 and 61 for separate high-resolution charts.
patterns.chineseText: 花鸟围巾组合参考图：左侧成品照，右上为花朵符号图解（粉色），右下为鸟符号图解（蓝色）。花朵环形起针，鸟在蓝色辫子针位置入针钩。
patterns.notes: Combined reference image. Flower motifs and bird motifs are crocheted separately, then joined to form the scarf. Multiple flower sizes create a gradient ombre effect.

patterns.englishText:
Flower Motif — Symbol Chart (5-petal layered flower)

Center: MR
Rnd 1: *(Ch 3, 2 tr in ring, ch 3, sl st in ring)*, repeat 5 times (5 small petals)
Rnd 2: Working behind petals — *ch 5, sc between petals*, repeat around (5 ch-5 loops)
Rnd 3: In each ch-5 loop: (sc, hdc, dc, 3 tr, dc, hdc, sc) — 5 medium petals
Rnd 4: Working behind petals — *ch 7, sc between petals*, repeat around (5 ch-7 loops)
Rnd 5: In each ch-7 loop: (sc, hdc, 2 dc, 5 tr, 2 dc, hdc, sc) — 5 large outer petals
Fasten off, weave in ends.
patterns.chineseText:
花朵图解（5瓣花符号图）
中心环形起针，由内向外钩织多层花瓣。
第1层：5个小花瓣（锁针+长长针组合）
第2层：在花瓣后方钩锁针环，形成5个较大花瓣
第3层：继续在后方加锁针环，钩出最大层花瓣
花瓣由短针、中长针、长针、长长针组合成扇形
patterns.notes: Symbol chart — layered 5-petal flower worked from center outward. Each petal layer is built by crocheting chain loops behind the previous layer. Exact stitch counts should be verified against the symbol chart; the translation above captures the general structure. Part of the flower & bird scarf.

patterns.englishText:
Bird Motif — Symbol Chart (Hummingbird)

Freeform crochet bird worked from tail to beak.
- Tail: Start with chain, work branching tail feathers using ch and sc
- Body: Built with sc and dc stitches in rows/short rows
- Wings: Fan-shaped shell stitch groupings (dc clusters) radiating outward
- Head & Beak: Sc decreases for shaping, ch for beak

This is an artistic freeform piece — follow the symbol chart closely for stitch placement, direction changes, and shaping. Symbols: X = sc, T = dc, o = ch.
patterns.chineseText:
鸟图解（蜂鸟符号图）
自由造型钩织，从尾部起针，依次钩出尾羽、身体、翅膀、头部和喙。
使用短针(X)、长针(T)、锁针(o)等符号。
翅膀部分使用扇形针组合向外展开。
尾羽使用锁针链形成细长分叉。
patterns.notes: Freeform hummingbird symbol chart. This is a complex artistic piece requiring careful reading of the symbol chart for exact stitch placement. The bird is crocheted as a flat applique and sewn onto the scarf. Part of the flower & bird scarf.

meta.intro: A gradient ombre scarf decorated with layered crocheted flower motifs and freeform hummingbird appliques. It's a statement wearable that combines lacy motif work with artistic applique for a romantic, garden-inspired look.

faq.question: How is the scarf assembled?
faq.answer: The flower motifs and the hummingbird appliques are crocheted separately and then joined and sewn together to build the scarf, with multiple flower sizes arranged to create a gradient ombre effect.

faq.question: How are the layered flower petals built?
faq.answer: The flower is worked from the center outward in layers: after each round of petals you work chain loops (ch 5, then ch 7) behind the petals, and the next, larger petal layer is crocheted into those loops.

faq.question: Is the hummingbird hard to make?
faq.answer: Yes, the bird is an artistic freeform piece worked from tail to beak, so you'll need to read the symbol chart closely (X = sc, T = dc, o = ch) for exact stitch placement, direction changes, and shaping.

faq.question: Why do my stitch counts not match exactly?
faq.answer: The written flower counts capture the general structure only; the notes recommend verifying exact stitch counts against the symbol chart, which is the authoritative reference for this pattern.

patterns.englishText:
Sparrow (小山雀) — Complete Pattern
Key: X=sc, V=sc inc, A=sc dec, T=hdc, F=dc, FA=dc dec, TA=hdc dec, CH=chain

BODY (in the round):
Rnd 1: 7 sc in MR (7)
Rnd 2: sc inc in each st (14)
Rnd 3: *sc inc, 3 sc* ×3, sc inc, sc (18)
Rnd 4–5: sc in each st (18)
Rnd 6: 2 sc inc, 4×(sc, 3 sc inc) — verify stitch count
Rnd 7: sc inc, 30 sc, sc inc — verify count
Rnd 8: sc inc, 32 sc, sc inc — verify count
Rnd 9: sc inc, 34 sc, sc inc — verify count
Rnd 10: ch 2, dc dec, 26 sc, sc dec, hdc dec, dc dec

BEAK: Using contrasting color, ch 2, fasten off. Insert at Rnd 4 between sts 9 and 10.

TAIL: Ch 7, starting from 3rd ch from hook: hdc, sc, sl st ×3. Fasten off. Sew into first and last st of Rnd 9.

CLOSING:
Rnd 11: *sc, sc dec, sc* ×8 — stuff before this round (attach beak & tail first)
Rnd 12: *sc, sc dec* ×8
Rnd 13: hdc dec ×8
Fasten off, weave in ends.

WINGS (make 2, flat):
Leave long starting tail for sewing.
Row 1: Ch 5, sc in 2nd ch from hook, 3 sc, sc inc — change color
Row 2: Ch 1, turn, 4 sc, sc inc — change color
Row 3: Ch 1, turn, 6 sc
Row 4: Ch 1, turn, skip 1 st, 4 sc, (hdc, dc inc) in same st, ch 1 — fasten off leaving long tail
Attach left wing: insert at 5 sts left of beak, one row below. Right wing symmetrically.
patterns.chineseText: 小山雀图解（全套）。身体：环起,R1:7X,R2:7V,R3:*(V,3X),V,X(18),R4-5:18X,R6:2V,4*(X,3V),R7:V,30X,V,R8:V,32X,V,R9:V,34X,V,R10:2CH,FA,26X,A,TA,FA。嘴巴：取色线钩2CH断线，在R4第9和第10针入针。尾巴：7CH倒三钩T,X,3SL断线，缝入R9首尾针。R11:8*(X,A,X)塞棉（建议先缝嘴尾），R12:8*(X,A)，R13:8*TA，断线藏线。翅膀×2（片钩）：R1:5CH倒二钩3X,V换线；R2:1CH翻4X,V换线；R3:1CH翻6X；R4:1CH翻空一针4X(T,FV),1CH断线。左翅从嘴左第5针下一行同位置入针缝合。
patterns.notes: Rnd 6–9 stitch counts need verification — formula likely follows amigurumi standard increases. The body shaping creates the round bird form. Stuff firmly before closing.

meta.intro: A small amigurumi sparrow (tit) with shaped body, attached beak, tail, and two flat color-blocked wings. This little bird makes a sweet ornament, shelf decoration, or pocket-sized handmade gift for bird lovers.
materials: Main color yarn for the body
Contrasting color yarn for the beak

faq.question: When should I attach the beak and tail?
faq.answer: Attach the beak (inserted at Rnd 4 between stitches 9 and 10) and the tail (sewn into the first and last stitch of Rnd 9) before the closing rounds, and stuff the body firmly just before Rnd 11.

faq.question: How are the wings positioned?
faq.answer: Each wing is made flat with a long starting tail for sewing; the left wing is inserted 5 stitches left of the beak and one row below, and the right wing is placed symmetrically on the other side.

faq.question: Some round stitch counts say 'verify count' — what should I do?
faq.answer: Rounds 6-9 follow standard amigurumi increase spacing, so work the increases evenly around to reach the body width and check your totals against the chart, since the written counts are flagged as needing verification.

patterns.englishText: Granny Square Chart — 'Ooh Holiday' motif by Little Mic (@小仙女的毛线圈). Symbol chart for a circular-to-square granny square worked from center outward. Features multiple rounds of bobble stitches and shell/fan clusters forming a square motif. Read counterclockwise from center. Finished size approx. 20×20cm. Full written pattern not transcribable from chart image alone — follow the chart symbols using the stitch reference (post 4, images 1–2).
patterns.chineseText: 方形花片（Ooh Holiday by Little Mic/@小仙女的毛线圈）符号钩织图解。由圆形中心向四角扩展，多圈蕾丝花样含枣形针和扇形花纹，最终为正方形。
patterns.notes: Complex granny square chart; requires symbol reference to read. Color scheme: blue, light blue, yellow, peach (see post images 1–5 for colorway guidance).

meta.intro: A festive circular-to-square granny square motif worked from the center outward, full of bobbles and shell clusters. It makes a charming standalone coaster or a building block for blankets, bags, and cushions.

faq.question: How do I read this granny square chart?
faq.answer: Work it from the center outward, reading each round counterclockwise. You'll need the accompanying stitch-symbol reference (images 1-2 of post 4) to interpret the bobble and shell/fan cluster symbols.

faq.question: What colors does the original use?
faq.answer: The sample colorway is blue, light blue, yellow, and peach. See post images 1-5 for guidance on which rounds take which color, but any four-color combination you like will work.

faq.question: Can I join several of these into a blanket?
faq.answer: Yes. At roughly 20x20cm each, these motifs join edge-to-edge with slip stitch or whip stitch to build blankets, cushion covers, or bags.

patterns.englishText:
Lizard Tom Pattern — Body + Inner Mouth + Tongue
Key: x=sc, f=dc, t=hdc, fv=dc inc, fa=dc dec, tv=hdc inc, ta=hdc dec, a=sc dec, w=sc 3-in-1

BODY (worked in rounds, main stitch: dc):
Rnd 1: 4 dc in MR (4)
Rnd 2: (dc, dc inc) ×2 (6)
Rnd 3: 6 dc (6)
Rnd 4: (dc, dc inc, dc) ×2 (8)
Rnd 5: (3 dc, dc inc) ×2 (10)
Rnd 6: 10 dc (10)
Rnd 7: 2 sc, hdc, 4 dc inc, hdc, 2 sc (14)
Rnd 8: sc dec, hdc inc, 8 dc, hdc inc, sc dec (14)
Rnd 9–11: sc dec, hdc inc, 8 dc, hdc inc, sc dec (14)
Rnd 12: hdc dec, 10 dc, hdc dec (12)
Rnd 13: dc inc, 2 dc, 6 hdc, 2 dc, dc inc (16)
Rnd 14: 2 dc, 3 hdc, 4 sc, 3 hdc, 2 dc (14)
Fasten off, invisible join, pull tight.

INNER MOUTH (oval, in sc):
Rnd 1: Ch 10, work oval around: 8 sc, sc 3-in-1 at tip, 7 sc back, sc inc at start-end
Rnd 2: sc inc, 7 sc, sc inc ×3 at tip, 7 sc, sc inc ×2 at other end
Rnd 3: (sc, sc inc) ×1, 7 sc, (sc, sc inc) ×3, 7 sc, (sc, sc inc) ×2
Fasten off, invisible weave.

TONGUE:
Ch 10, starting from 3rd ch from hook: 8 hdc. Fasten off.
patterns.chineseText:
小蜥蜴汤姆图解（主体+嘴巴里面部分+舌头）。符号：x=短针,f=长针,t=中长针,fv=长针加针,fa=长针减针,tv=中长针加针,ta=中长针减针,a=短针减针,w=短针1放3。
主体：R1:环起4f; R2:2(f,fv); R3:6f; R4:2(f,fv,f); R5:2(3f,fv); R6:10f; R7:2x,t,4fv,t,2x; R8:a,tv,8f,tv,a; R9-R11:同R8; R12:ta,10f,at; R13:fv,2f,6t,2f,fv; R14:2f,3t,4x,3t,2f。断线藏线。
嘴巴里面：R1:起10ch椭圆形：8x,w,7x,v; R2:v,7x,3v,7x,2v; R3:(x,v),7x,3(x,v),7x,2(x,v)。断线。
舌头：起10ch,倒3织8t。
patterns.notes: Main body uses dc (long stitch) as primary stitch — unusual for amigurumi. Stitch counts for Rnds 8–12 should be verified by crafter.

patterns.englishText:
Lizard Tom — Upper Jaw + Lower Jaw + Assembly

UPPER JAW (flat piece, in dc):
Row 1: dc inc, 6 dc, dc inc (10)
Row 2: dc dec, 8 dc, dc dec (8)
Row 3: dc dec, 4 dc, dc dec (6)
Row 4: dc dec, 2 dc, dc dec (4)
Fasten off.

LOWER JAW (flat piece, in hdc):
Row 1: 6 hdc (from a chain start) (6)
Row 2: hdc dec, 2 hdc, hdc dec (4)

ASSEMBLY: Join Inner Mouth to Lower Jaw and crochet together; work one round of sc around entire mouth edge. Upper jaw picks up 8 sts; lower jaw picks up 6 sts (see photo for reference).
patterns.chineseText: 小蜥蜴汤姆图解（上嘴+下嘴+组合）。上嘴-片织：R1:fv,6f,fv(10); R2:fa,8f,fa(8); R3:fa,4f,fa(6); R4:fa,2f,fa(4)。断线。下嘴-片织：R1:6t; R2:ta,2t,ta(4)。把嘴巴里面部分跟着一起织，沿着嘴巴织一圈。组合时参考实物图：上嘴8针目入针，下嘴6针目入针。
patterns.notes: Upper jaw in dc, lower jaw in hdc. Assembly photo shows final mouth orientation.

patterns.englishText:
Lizard Tom — Eyes + Hands + Feet

EYES (make 2):
Rnd 1: 6 sc in MR (6)
Rnd 2: 6 sc (6)
Fasten off and sew to body.

HANDS (make 2) — attach directly to body:
Insert hook at appropriate position between Rnds 12–13 on body, working in BLO.
Ch 7, sl st in 2nd ch from hook ×2, ch 2, sl st ×2, ch 2, sl st ×2, then 4 sc back at base.
(Creates 3 finger-like extensions.)

FEET (make 2) — attach directly to body:
Insert hook at appropriate position between Rnds 7–8 on body, working in BLO.
Ch 8, sl st in 2nd ch from hook ×2, ch 2, sl st ×2, then 5 sc back at base.
(Creates 2 toe-like extensions.)
patterns.chineseText: 小蜥蜴汤姆图解（眼睛+手+脚）。眼睛×2：R1:环起6x; R2:6x。手×2：主体R12-R13处入针，都织里山，起7ch倒2织2sl,起2ch倒2织2sl,起2ch倒2织2sl,4x。脚×2：主体R7-R8处入针，都织里山，起8ch倒2织2sl,起2ch倒2织2sl,5x。
patterns.notes: Hands and feet are worked directly into the body, not made separately. BLO = back loop only throughout.

meta.intro: Lizard Tom is a small amigurumi lizard with an opening jaw, inner mouth, tongue, and crocheted-on fingers and toes. His charm comes from the playful articulated mouth and the unusual double-crochet body that gives him a long, sleek shape.

faq.question: Why is the body worked in double crochet instead of single crochet?
faq.answer: The pattern intentionally uses dc as the main body stitch to create a longer, sleeker lizard shape. This is unusual for amigurumi, so be aware the looser dc fabric may show stuffing more than tight sc work.

faq.question: How are the hands and feet attached?
faq.answer: They aren't made separately. You insert your hook directly into the body in back loops only (BLO) and crochet them on in place: hands between Rnds 12-13 (three finger extensions) and feet between Rnds 7-8 (two toe extensions).

faq.question: How do I assemble the mouth?
faq.answer: Join the inner mouth to the lower jaw and crochet them together, then work one round of sc around the entire mouth edge. The upper jaw picks up 8 stitches and the lower jaw picks up 6; use the assembly photo for correct orientation.

faq.question: The stitch counts for Rnds 8-12 look tricky. Anything to watch?
faq.answer: Yes. The designer notes that the counts for Rnds 8-12 should be verified as you go, since these rounds mix sc, hdc, and dc with increases and decreases. Count after each round and compare to the bracketed total.
